steps.title: Chapter9
steps.contentHtml:
Book I နိဂုံးချက်

"သစ္စာသည် ဓားထက်ထက်မြက်၏။ သို့သော် သစ္စာကို ထိန်းသိမ်းခြင်းသည် ဓားကို ကိုင်ဆောင်ခြင်းထက် ပို၍ ခက်ခဲလေ၏။"

နန်းတော်မှ ပြန်လာသော သံပါးစပ်သည် ကျောက်စိမ်းအိမ်တော်၏ ခြံဝင်းအတွင်းသို့ တိတ်ဆိတ်စွာ လျှောက်ဝင်လာသည်။ နေဝင်အလင်းသည် ကျောက်နံရံများပေါ်သို့ ရွှေရောင်သမ်းနေသော်လည်း သူ၏စိတ်ထဲတွင်မူ နေ့တစ်နေ့ပြီးဆုံးသွားသည်ဟု မထင်ရသေးပေ။ ယနေ့မှစ၍ သူသည် ရွာသားမဟုတ်တော့။ ဘုရင်၏ အမှုထမ်းတစ်ဦး ဖြစ်လာခဲ့ပြီ။

Lord မဟာသီဟကျော်သည် ခြံဝင်းအလယ်တွင် ရပ်လျက် သူ့ကို ကြည့်နေသည်။ သံပါးစပ် နီးကပ်လာသောအခါ ခေါင်းညိတ်ရုံသာ ပြုလိုက်ပြီး အပြုံးမပြပေ။

"ယနေ့မှစ၍ သင်သည် ငါ၏လူတစ်ယောက်သာ မဟုတ်တော့။ အင်းဝ၏ လူတစ်ယောက် ဖြစ်လာပြီ။"

သံပါးစပ်သည် ဦးညွှတ်၍ ပြန်လည်ဖြေကြားသည်။

"ကျွန်ုပ်၏ အသက်သည် ကျောက်စိမ်းအိမ်တော်နှင့် အင်းဝအတွက်သာ ဖြစ်ပါသည်။"

အနီးတွင် ရပ်နေသော ဗိုလ်နန္ဒက ခပ်ပြုံးပြုံးဖြင့် ပခုံးကို ပုတ်လိုက်သော်လည်း သူ၏မျက်လုံးထဲတွင် ပျော်ရွှင်မှုထက် စိုးရိမ်မှုက ပိုများနေသည်။

"အခုမှ စစ်သားဘဝ စတာပဲ။ အရှေ့မှာ သွေးတွေ အများကြီး စောင့်နေသေးတယ်။"

သံပါးစပ်သည် စကားမပြန်ဘဲ တောင်ဘက်ကောင်းကင်ကိုသာ ငေးကြည့်နေ၏။ အဝေးတစ်နေရာတွင် မိုးတိမ်မည်းများ စုဝေးလာနေသကဲ့သို့ စစ်၏အရိပ်သည်လည်း နီးကပ်လာနေသည်။

ထိုအချိန်၌ မြင်းစီးသတင်းပို့တစ်ဦးသည် ဖုန်အလိမ်းလိမ်းဖြင့် အိမ်တော်သို့ အလျင်အမြန် ရောက်ရှိလာပြီး Lord မဟာသီဟကျော်ထံ တံဆိပ်ပိတ်စာတစ်စောင်ကို ဆက်သလိုက်သည်။

စာကို ဖတ်ပြီးနောက် Lord မဟာသီဟကျော်၏ မျက်နှာအမူအရာ ပြောင်းလဲသွားသည်။

"ဟံသာဝတီသည် စစ်တပ်များ စုစည်းနေပြီ..."

တစ်ခဏအကြာတွင် အခြားလူတစ်ဦးသည် မည်သူမျှ မသိလိုက်ဘဲ အိမ်တော်တံခါးဝ၌ စာတစ်စောင် ထားခဲ့ပြီး အရိပ်အဖြစ် ပျောက်ကွယ်သွားသည်။

စာအိတ်ပေါ်တွင် စကားတစ်ကြောင်းသာ ရေးသားထား၏။

"အရိပ်တော်"

စာကို ဖွင့်ကြည့်သောအခါ အတွင်းတွင် စာကြောင်းတိုတစ်ကြောင်းသာ တွေ့ရသည်။

"ရန်သူသည် နယ်စပ်၌သာ မရှိ။ နန်းတော်အတွင်း၌လည်း ရှိ၏။"

Lord မဟာသီဟကျော်သည် စာကို မီးတိုင်ထဲသို့ ပစ်ချလိုက်သော်လည်း ထိုစကားများသည် မီးထဲတွင် မလောင်ကျွမ်းဘဲ လူတိုင်း၏ စိတ်ထဲတွင်သာ ကျန်ရစ်ခဲ့သည်။

သံပါးစပ်သည် မိုးကုပ်စက်ဝိုင်းကို ငေးကြည့်လျက် သံမေးရိုးကို လက်ဖြင့် ငြိမ်သက်စွာ ထိလိုက်သည်။

သူ မသိသေးသည်မှာ မကြာမီ သူ၏ဓားသည် ရန်သူ၏သွေးတင်မက မိတ်ဆွေ၏သွေးကိုပါ မြည်းစမ်းရတော့မည်ဖြစ်ပြီး၊ သစ္စာကို ကာကွယ်ရန် သစ္စာရှိသူများပင် အသက်ပေးရမည့်နေ့များ ရောက်လာတော့မည်ဖြစ်သည်။

ထိုညတွင် အင်းဝမြို့တော်သည် တိတ်ဆိတ်နေသော်လည်း တိတ်ဆိတ်မှုအောက်၌ မုန်တိုင်းတစ်ခုသည် အသံမရှိဘဲ စတင်လှုပ်ရှားနေပြီဖြစ်၏။

"စစ်သည် မစသေး။
သို့သော် သစ္စာဖောက်မှုကား စတင်နေပြီ။"

Book I ပြီးဆုံး။

Next — Book II : သစ္စာနှင့် သွေးကြွေး

Describe Abstract class vs Interface
Summarize how polymorphism improves design
steps.contentHtml:
SOLID Principles & OOP Interview Cheat Sheet

Review the most common interview questions about SOLID principles, Abstract Class vs Interface, and Polymorphism. Master these concepts to write cleaner, maintainable, and extensible object-oriented applications.

💡 Interview Tip:
Most .NET interviews ask:
  • Explain the SOLID principles.
  • When would you use an Interface instead of an Abstract Class?
  • What is Polymorphism? Give a real-world example.
Topic Short Answer Key Idea Real-world Example Why It Matters
SOLID Five OO design principles Build clean, flexible, maintainable software. Insurance system that grows without rewriting existing code. Easy to maintain and extend.
SRP
Single Responsibility Principle		 One class = One responsibility A class should have only one reason to change. PremiumCalculator only calculates premiums. Simpler testing and maintenance.
OCP
Open / Closed Principle		 Extend without modifying Add new features without changing existing code. Add TravelPolicy without changing existing policies. Lower risk when adding features.
LSP
Liskov Substitution Principle		 Child objects replace parent objects safely Derived classes should behave correctly wherever the base class is used. MotorPolicy works anywhere a Policy is expected. Reliable inheritance.
ISP
Interface Segregation Principle		 Small focused interfaces Clients shouldn't implement methods they don't need. IClaimable and IRenewable are separate. Cleaner architecture.
DIP
Dependency Inversion Principle		 Depend on abstractions High-level modules depend on interfaces instead of concrete classes. ClaimService → IPaymentService Easy unit testing and dependency injection.
Abstract Class vs Interface Abstract = shared implementation
Interface = contract 		Abstract classes can contain code and state.
Interfaces define capabilities. 		Policy (Abstract)
IClaimable (Interface) 		Choose the correct level of abstraction.
Polymorphism Same method, different behaviour Different objects respond differently to the same method call. CalculateClaim() behaves differently for Car, Travel and Health policies. Reusable and extensible business logic.

Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Interview Cheat Sheet

Review the fundamental Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts that every software developer should know. These concepts are frequently asked during .NET, Java, C++, and general software engineering interviews.

💡 Interview Tip
  • Know the four pillars of OOP: Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, and Polymorphism.
  • Understand the difference between a Class and an Object.
  • Be ready to explain each concept with a simple real-world example.
Concept Definition Explanation Example Benefit
Class A blueprint for creating objects. A class defines the properties (fields) and behaviours (methods) that its objects will have. class Animal { } Organizes code into reusable templates.
Object An instance of a class. Objects are real runtime instances created from a class and contain actual data. Animal dog = new Animal(); Models real-world entities in software.
Encapsulation Protect data by controlling access. Keep data private and expose it through methods or properties to prevent invalid changes. private int age;
public int Age { get; set; } 		Improves security, validation, and maintainability.
Abstraction Hide implementation details. Show only the essential behaviour while hiding the internal complexity from users. abstract class Shape Simplifies application design and reduces complexity.
Inheritance Reuse code through parent-child relationships. A child class inherits properties and methods from a parent class and can extend or override behaviour. class Dog : Animal Promotes code reuse and easier maintenance.
Polymorphism One interface, many implementations. The same method call can produce different behaviour depending on the object's actual type. animal.Sound();
Dog → Bark
Cat → Meow 		Produces flexible and extensible applications.
Constructor Initializes an object. A constructor runs automatically when an object is created and sets its initial state. public Dog(){ Age = 1; } Ensures objects start in a valid state.

steps.title: Explain Design Patterns
checklist: Explain Singleton and Factory patterns
Describe Observer and reuse patterns
Summarize when to use these design patterns
steps.contentHtml:
Design Patterns Interview Cheat Sheet

Design patterns are proven solutions to common software design problems. They help developers write flexible, reusable, and maintainable applications. Interviewers often ask when and why you would use a particular pattern.

💡 Interview Tip
  • Know the purpose of each pattern instead of memorizing definitions.
  • Be able to explain a real-world use case.
  • Understand when to use each pattern and its advantages.
Pattern Definition Explanation Example Benefit
Singleton Only one instance exists. Ensures a class has a single shared instance throughout the application. Logger, Configuration Manager, Cache Manager Saves memory and provides centralized access.
Factory Create objects without using new. Encapsulates object creation so clients don't depend on concrete classes. PolicyFactory.Create() Easier maintenance and extension.
Observer Notify multiple objects automatically. When one object changes, all subscribed objects receive updates. Email notifications, Event handlers Loose coupling and automatic updates.
Strategy Choose an algorithm at runtime. Encapsulates different algorithms behind a common interface. Different payment methods or discount calculations. Flexible business rules.
Builder Build complex objects step by step. Separates object construction from its representation. Creating reports, invoices, or HTTP requests. Cleaner object creation.
Repository Separate data access from business logic. Provides a clean interface for database operations. CustomerRepository Easier testing and database independence.
Dependency Injection (DI) Provide dependencies from outside. Objects receive required services instead of creating them directly. ASP.NET Core built-in DI Container. Loose coupling and easier unit testing.

steps.title: Explain ARCHITECTURE & SYSTEM
checklist: Explain hybrid architecture
Describe monolith vs microservices
Summarize scalability and polymorphism in architecture
steps.contentHtml:
Architecture & System Design Review

Review the architecture and system design concepts that frequently appear in software engineering interviews. Focus on understanding the idea, when to use it, and the value it provides in real-world applications.

Concept Short Definition Explanation Example Why It Matters
Hybrid Architecture Separate UI and Backend Frontend communicates with backend APIs, allowing each layer to evolve independently. React + ASP.NET Core Web API Cleaner architecture and easier maintenance.
Monolith vs Microservices One application vs many services A monolith packages everything into one application, while microservices divide features into independent services. Policy Service, Claim Service and Billing Service Improves scalability and team productivity.
Scalability Handle increasing workloads A scalable application continues performing well as more users and requests arrive. Insurance claim portal during peak claim periods Maintains fast response time.
Compile-time vs Runtime Polymorphism Overloading vs Overriding Overloading is resolved during compilation, while overriding is determined at runtime. Calculate() overload vs CalculateClaim() override Creates flexible and reusable code.
Singleton vs Factory Reuse vs Create Objects Singleton guarantees a single shared instance, while Factory centralizes object creation. Logger and PolicyFactory Reduces coupling and simplifies maintenance.
REST API HTTP-based communication Applications exchange data through standard HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT and DELETE. GET /api/products Standard communication between frontend and backend.
Stateless API No server-side session Every request contains all information required to process it without remembering previous requests. JWT Authentication Supports horizontal scaling and load balancing.
Load Balancer Distribute traffic Routes incoming requests across multiple servers to prevent overload. AWS Application Load Balancer Improves availability and performance.
Caching Store frequently used data Keeps commonly requested information in memory instead of repeatedly querying the database. Redis Cache Faster response times and lower database load.
Message Queue Asynchronous communication Applications exchange messages without waiting for immediate processing. RabbitMQ, IBM MQ Improves reliability and system throughput.
Horizontal vs Vertical Scaling Add servers vs Bigger server Horizontal scaling adds more machines, while vertical scaling increases the resources of one machine. Kubernetes Pods vs Upgrading CPU/RAM Supports growing business demands.
High Availability Minimize downtime Uses redundancy and failover mechanisms so services remain available even when servers fail. Multiple API servers behind a load balancer Keeps business applications online.

steps.contentHtml:
Angular Interview Review

Review Angular authentication, lifecycle hooks, NgRx state management, routing, dependency injection, and frontend communication with ASP.NET Core Web APIs. These are common interview topics for Angular and Full Stack developers.

Interview Question Short Answer Explanation Example Why It Matters
What is AuthGuard? Protects application routes AuthGuard determines whether a user can navigate to a route based on authentication or authorization. Redirect unauthenticated users to Login. Secures private pages.
How do you implement AuthGuard? Implement CanActivate Create a guard service that checks authentication and returns true or false before navigation. Validate JWT before opening Dashboard. Centralized route security.
What is ngOnChanges? Triggered when inputs change Runs whenever an @Input() property changes and provides previous and current values. Refresh child component after parent data changes. Respond to external updates.
What is ngOnInit? Initialize component Runs once after Angular initializes component inputs. Load products from API. Best place for startup logic.
What is ngDoCheck? Custom change detection Runs during every Angular change detection cycle for advanced scenarios. Detect deep object changes. Supports complex UI updates.
What is ngAfterContentInit? Projected content initialized Runs after external content is inserted using <ng-content>. Initialize projected templates. Work with projected content.
What is ngAfterContentChecked? Content checked Runs after every content change detection. Validate projected data. Monitor content updates.
What is ngAfterViewInit? View initialized Runs after component view and child views are fully created. Access @ViewChild. Safe DOM access.
What is ngAfterViewChecked? View checked Runs after each view change detection. Update UI after rendering. Synchronize UI state.
What is ngOnDestroy? Cleanup before removal Release resources before Angular destroys the component. Unsubscribe Observables. Prevents memory leaks.
What is NgRx? State management library Centralizes application state using Store, Actions, Reducers and Effects. User authentication state. Predictable application state.
What are NgRx Actions? Represent events Actions describe what happened inside the application. LoginSuccess Clear application flow.
What are NgRx Reducers? Update state Pure functions that return a new immutable state. Update logged-in user. Easy debugging.
What are NgRx Effects? Handle side effects Perform asynchronous work such as HTTP requests. Load products from API. Keeps reducers pure.
What are NgRx Selectors? Read Store data Retrieve specific data efficiently using memoized functions. Select current user. Better performance.
How does Angular communicate with .NET? HTTP + JSON Angular sends HTTP requests using HttpClient and receives JSON from ASP.NET Core APIs. GET /api/products Frontend-backend integration.
What is HttpClient? HTTP service Angular service for GET, POST, PUT and DELETE requests. http.get() Simplifies API calls.
How do you handle HTTP errors? catchError() Use RxJS operators or subscribe error callbacks to process failed requests. Display "Product not found". Improves user experience.
What is Two-Way Data Binding? Model ↔ View synchronization Keeps UI and component data synchronized automatically. [(ngModel)] Less manual coding.
What is Angular Routing? SPA navigation Navigate between components without reloading the page. /dashboard Smooth user experience.
What is Dependency Injection (DI)? Inject services Angular automatically provides dependencies through constructors. constructor(private userService: UserService) Loose coupling and easier testing.

👋 Chapter 3 - Hello World

🧩 Build Your Own Program

Tap the word blocks in the order you want them to print, then press Run!

Tap blocks above to build your program...
CONSOLE OUTPUT
Challenge
🎯 Try to make it print: Hello World !

📖 Order Matters!

A program is a list of instructions that run in order, one after another. This order is called a sequence.

If you mix up the order, you get a mixed-up result - even if you use the exact same instructions!

console.log("Hello"); console.log("World"); console.log("!"); // prints, in this exact order: // Hello // World // !
🌟 Did you know?

"Hello, World!" is the very first program that most programmers ever write. It's a tradition! It teaches that a computer runs your instructions in the exact sequence you write them.

steps.title: HelloWorld-Explain
steps.contentHtml:
👋

Hello World - Explained

CONCEPT 1

📜 What is a Sequence?

A sequence is just a fancy word for "the order things happen in." When you make a sandwich, you do steps in order:

1

Get two pieces of bread

2

Add the filling

3

Put the bread together

If you did step 3 before step 1, it wouldn't work! Computers are the same - they follow instructions in the order you write them, from top to bottom.

CONCEPT 2

💻 Same Words, Different Order

Here's something surprising: using the exact same instructions but in a different order gives you a totally different result!

console.log("Hello"); console.log("World");
✅ Correct Order
🔀 Swapped Order
CONCEPT 3

⚙️ How the Computer Reads Your Program

The computer reads your program like a story - one line, then the next line, then the next - and it never skips ahead or peeks at later lines first.

1

Read line 1 and do exactly what it says.

2

Move to line 2 and do exactly what it says.

3

Keep going until there are no more lines left.

This is why programmers say a program "runs from top to bottom" - and why getting the sequence right matters so much!

🌟 Ready to play?

Now that you know why sequence matters, go back to Hello-World chapter and try building the blocks in the right order to print "Hello World" if you want!

steps.title: MazeWalker-Explain
steps.contentHtml:
🧭

Maze Walker - Explained

Chapter 04 · Commands (Move Up/Down/Left/Right)
CONCEPT 1

🎮 What is a Command?

A command is a single, simple instruction that tells the computer to do one exact thing right now - like "move up!"

Unlike a whole program with many steps, a command usually does just one job, and the computer does it immediately.

CONCEPT 2

📍 Commands Change Coordinates

Every character in a maze has a position made of two numbers: a row and a column. Each command changes one of those numbers:

  • ⬆️ Up → row goes down by 1
  • ⬇️ Down → row goes up by 1
  • ⬅️ Left → column goes down by 1
  • ➡️ Right → column goes up by 1
if (dir === "up") row = row - 1; if (dir === "down") row = row + 1; if (dir === "left") col = col - 1; if (dir === "right") col = col + 1;
row: 2, col: 2
CONCEPT 3

🚧 What About Walls?

Before moving, the computer checks: "is there a wall at the new spot?" If yes, the command is ignored - the character stays put. If no, the move happens.

1

Get the command (up, down, left, or right).

2

Figure out the new row/column that command would move to.

3

Check if that spot is a wall or off the edge of the maze.

4

If it's clear, move there. If not, do nothing.

🌟 Ready to play?

Now you know how commands move a character step by step and why walls can block them. Go back again to Maze-Walker chapter and guide the walker to the flag if you want!

Chapter 05 - 🔨🐹Whack-a-Mole

Events (Click)
Play Guide
Press start game & hit the moles before they hide!
SCORE
0

20

📖 What is an Event?

An event is something that happens - like a click!

The computer waits quietly until you click, then it runs your code. That's called "listening" for an event.

💻 JavaScript Code

hole.addEventListener("click", () => { if (hole.classList.contains("up")) { score++; } });
🌟 Did you know?

Every time you click a button, tap a screen, or press a key, you are triggering an event. Programmers write code that says "when this event happens, do this!"

steps.title: Whack-a-Mole-Explain

🔨🐹

How Whack-a-Mole Works

Let's see what happens inside the computer!

💻 Our Program

hole.addEventListener("click", () => { if (hole.classList.contains("up")) { score++; } });
1

🧠 The Computer Waits

The computer doesn't do anything at first. It just quietly waits and listens for something to happen.

⬇️
2

🐹 A Mole Pops Up

Every second or so, a random hole shows its mole. This happens on its own, without you clicking anything.

⬇️
3

👆 You Click!

The moment you click a hole, that's an event - something just happened!

⬇️
4

🔎 The Computer Checks

"Was a mole actually up in that hole?" If yes - point scored! If not, nothing happens.

⬇️
5

🏆 The Score Updates

The screen instantly shows your new score.

Try It

0

🌟 Remember

Click events don't run in order like a list of steps - they run whenever the click happens. That's what makes them different from a program like Maze Walker!

steps.title: Falling-Catcher-Explain
steps.contentHtml:
🧺🍎

Falling Catcher - Explained

Chapter 9 · Game Loop + Keyboard Events + Score
CONCEPT 1

📦 Collision Detection

Every game object is really just an invisible rectangle (a "box"). To check if two things are touching, we compare their boxes: their left/right edges and top/bottom edges.

If all four of these are true, the boxes overlap:

  • Box A's left edge is before Box B's right edge
  • Box A's right edge is after Box B's left edge
  • Box A's top edge is before Box B's bottom edge
  • Box A's bottom edge is after Box B's top edge
function isColliding(a, b) { return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y; }
CONCEPT 2

🏓 Bounce

A "bounce" is just a direction flip. Every moving object has a velocity - a speed and direction, often split into vx (left/right speed) and vy (up/down speed).

When the object hits a wall, we multiply that velocity by -1. Same speed, opposite direction!

if (ball.x <= 0 || ball.x + ball.w >= stageWidth) { ball.vx *= -1; // flip left/right direction }
CONCEPT 3

⚙️ Game Physics Loop

Games don't move things all at once - they update a tiny bit, over and over, many times per second. That's the game loop.

1

Move every object a little bit, based on its velocity.

2

Check for collisions (did anything touch a wall, basket, or another object?).

3

React to what happened (bounce, catch, remove, add score).

4

Draw everything in its new position, then repeat - forever, ~60 times a second!

function gameLoop() { moveEverything(); checkCollisions(); requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop); // do it again next frame }
🌟 Ready to play?

Now that you know how collision detection and bounce work, go try 10-Falling-Catcher.html and watch for the moment fruit bounces off the walls or lands in your basket!

steps.title: Breakout-Explain
steps.contentHtml:
🧱🏓

Breakout - Explained

Chapter 10 · Collision Detection + Bounce + Game Physics
CONCEPT 1

📦 Collision Detection

In Breakout, the ball is always checking: "am I touching a wall? the paddle? a brick?" Every object is really an invisible rectangle (a "box"), and we compare box edges to know if two things overlap.

function isColliding(ball, box) { return ball.x < box.x + box.w && ball.x + ball.size > box.x && ball.y < box.y + box.h && ball.y + ball.size > box.y; }

If this is true, the ball has just hit that box - time to react!

CONCEPT 2

🏓 Bounce

The ball has a velocity: vx (left/right speed) and vy (up/down speed). A bounce is just flipping one of those - multiplying it by -1.

  • Hit a side wall → flip vx
  • Hit the top wall, a brick, or the paddle → flip vy
if (ball.x <= 0 || ball.x + size >= width) { ball.vx *= -1; // side wall bounce } if (ball.y <= 0) { ball.vy *= -1; // top wall bounce }
CONCEPT 3

⚙️ Game Physics Loop

Breakout updates the ball's position a tiny bit, checks for collisions, reacts, and redraws - over and over, ~60 times a second. That's the game loop.

1

Move the ball by its velocity: x += vx, y += vy.

2

Check collisions against walls, the paddle, and every brick.

3

React: bounce the ball, remove a broken brick, add to the score.

4

Redraw everything in its new spot, then repeat with requestAnimationFrame.

function gameLoop() { moveBall(); checkWallCollisions(); checkPaddleCollision(); checkBrickCollisions(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop); }
🌟 Ready to play?

Now you know how the ball bounces and how bricks get detected and destroyed. Go try 10-Breakout.html and watch the paddle angle change how the ball bounces!

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - The Sun Quiz</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:12px 16px 20px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container {
        padding: 10px 12px 16px;
      }
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:24px;
      color:#ffd700;
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .player-info{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:8px;
      margin-top:6px;
      font-size:16px;
      color:#ffd700;
      font-weight:bold;
    }
    .player-info span:first-child{
      font-size:24px;
    }
    .competition-bar{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:space-between;
      align-items:center;
      background:#1a1735;
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:10px;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    .competition-bar.hidden{display:none;}
    .competitor{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      gap:4px;
    }
    .competitor-icon{font-size:28px;}
    .competitor-name{font-size:12px;color:#c4b5fd;}
    .competitor-score{font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffd700;}
    .vs-divider{font-size:18px;color:#a78bfa;font-weight:bold;}
    .quiz-card{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:12px;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display:none;
    }
    .quiz-card.active{
      display:block;
    }
    .question{
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:bold;
      margin-bottom:10px;
      color:#fff;
    }
    .options{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:6px;
    }
    .option{
      padding:10px 14px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius:8px;
      cursor:pointer;
      font-size:14px;
      transition:0.2s;
    }
    .option:hover{
      background:#1a1735;
      border-color:#ffd700;
    }
    .option.correct{
      background:rgba(34,197,94,0.3);
      border-color:#22c55e;
    }
    .option.wrong{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,0.3);
      border-color:#ef4444;
    }
    .feedback{
      margin-top:8px;
      padding:8px;
      border-radius:8px;
      font-size:13px;
      display:none;
    }
    .feedback.show{
      display:block;
    }
    .feedback.correct{
      background:rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
      color:#4ade80;
    }
    .feedback.wrong{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
      color:#f87171;
    }
    .score-card{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.98), rgba(255,165,0,0.98));
      border-radius:24px;
      padding:10px 20px 60px;
      text-align:center;
      margin-top:20px;
      display:none;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.35);
      border:4px solid #fff176;
      z-index: 10;
      position: relative;
    }
    .score-card.show{
      display:block;
      animation: slideUp 0.5s ease-out;
    }
    @keyframes slideUp {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(30px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
    .score-card h2{
      font-size:26px;
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom:30px;
      color:#1a1240;
      text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }
    .score-display{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1240, #3a2f70);
      border-radius:18px;
      padding:18px;
      margin-bottom:18px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 20;
    }
    .score-card .score{
      font-size:52px;
      font-weight:bold;
      margin-bottom:6px;
      color:#ffe066;
      text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 224, 102, 0.7);
    }
    .score-label{
      font-size:13px;
      color:#d1c4ff;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing:2px;
    }
    .score-card .message{
      font-size:17px;
      margin-top:10px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-weight:bold;
      padding:10px;
      background:#1a1240;
      border-radius:12px;
    }
    .podium{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:flex-end;
      gap:14px;
      margin-top:120px;
      height:140px;
      padding:6px;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    .podium-place{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      gap:4px;
      transition:transform 0.3s ease;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .podium-place:hover{
      transform:translateY(-1px);
    }
    .podium-character{
      font-size:42px;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3));
      animation: none;
    }
    .podium-bar{
      border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      font-size:22px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#fff;
      position:relative;
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }
    .podium-bar.first{
      width:100px;
      height:100px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b8860b,#8b6914);
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(184,134,11,0.45);
    }
    .podium-bar.second{
      width:90px;
      height:80px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#c0c0c0,#a0a0a0);
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 18px rgba(192,192,192,0.35);
    }
    .rank-badge{
      position:absolute;
      top:-10px;
      font-size:26px;
      animation: none;
    }
    .podium-name{
      font-size:13px;
      color:#1a1240;
      margin-top:6px;
      text-align:center;
      font-weight:bold;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      padding:5px 9px;
      border-radius:8px;
    }
    .podium-score{
      font-size:15px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-weight:bold;
      background:#1a1240;
      padding:3px 7px;
      border-radius:6px;
    }
    .button-group{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      justify-content:center;
      margin-top:20px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
    }
    .retry-btn{
      padding:14px 28px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:14px;
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:all 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }
    .retry-btn{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1240,#3a2f70);
      color:#ffe066;
    }
    .retry-btn:hover{
      transform:scale(1.06);
      box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    }
    
    
    /* Mobile adjustments */
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .score-card {
        padding:10px 14px 60px;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }
      .score-card h2 {
        font-size: 20px;
      }
      .score-card .score {
        font-size: 10px;
      }
      .score-display {
        padding: 9px;
      }
      .score-card .message {
        margin-top: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        font-size: 14px;
        color:#ffffff;
        background:#1a1240;
      }
      .podium {
        height: 120px;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 6px;
        margin-top: 120px;
      }
      .podium-character {
        font-size: 36px;
      }
      .podium-bar.first {
        width: 85px;
        height: 90px;
        background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b8860b,#8b6914);
      }
      .podium-bar.second {
        width: 75px;
        height: 70px;
      }
      .rank-badge {
        font-size: 22px;
        top: -8px;
      }
      .button-group {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
      }
      .retry-btn {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
    }
    .nav-hint{
      margin-top:12px;
      text-align:center;
      font-size:11px;
      color:#a78bfa;
      background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
      padding:6px;
      border-radius:8px;
    }

<body class="reading-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ The Sun Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="playerScore">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="vs-divider">VS</div>
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="botIcon">☀️</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="botName">Solaris</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What is the Sun made of mostly?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Rock and metal</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">Hydrogen and helium</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Oxygen and carbon</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Water and ice</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. How hot is the Sun's surface?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">1,000°C</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">2,500°C</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">5,500°C</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">10,000°C</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. What process creates energy in the Sun?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Burning</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">Nuclear fusion</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Electricity</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Chemical reaction</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. How old is the Sun?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">1 million years</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">100 million years</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">1 billion years</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">4.6 billion years</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. What are dark spots on the Sun called?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">Sunspots</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Moon spots</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Star spots</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Dark holes</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-6">
    <div class="question">6. How long does it take for sunlight to reach Earth?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">1 second</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">1 minute</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, true)">8 minutes</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">1 hour</div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div class="score-card" id="scoreCard">
    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">☀️</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">Solaris</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="message" id="scoreMessage"></div>
    <div class="button-group">
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 6;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'Solaris';
  const botCharacter = '☀️';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - Mercury</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;

      min-height:100vh;

    .stars{
      position:fixed;

        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),

        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:24px 16px 40px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:20px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:32px;
      color:#b5b5b5;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .mercury-display{

      border-radius:50%;

      cursor:pointer;
      transition:transform 0.3s;
      animation:float 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .mercury:hover{
      transform:scale(1.1);
    }
    @keyframes float{
      0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}
      50%{transform:translateY(-10px);}
    }
    .card{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:20px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);

    .card h2{
      color:#b5b5b5;
      margin-bottom:12px;

    }

    <div class="touch-controls">
      <button class="touch-btn" id="leftBtn">⬅️</button>
      <button class="touch-btn" id="rightBtn">➡️</button>
    </div>
    <div class="game-score" id="gameScore">Score: 0</div>
    <div class="game-timer" id="gameTimer">Time: 30s</div>
    <div class="game-timer" id="gameLives">❤️❤️❤️</div>
    
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
const mercuryFacts = [
  "Mercury is named after the Roman messenger god!",
  "Mercury has no moons!",
  "Mercury has no rings!",
  "Mercury is the fastest planet - it orbits the Sun in just 88 days!",
  "Mercury has ice in craters that never see sunlight!",
  "Mercury's gravity is much weaker than Earth's!",
  "You would weigh much less on Mercury!",
  "Mercury has a huge crater called Caloris Basin!"
];


// Meteor Dodge Game - Canvas-based
let gameScore = 0;
let gameTime = 30;
let gameLives = 3;
let gameInterval;
let spawnInterval;
let animationFrame;
let isGameRunning = false;
let canvas, ctx;
let player;
let meteors = [];
let keys = {};
let moveLeft = false;
let moveRight = false;

function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  const _ss = document.getElementById('startScreen'); if (_ss) _ss.style.display = 'none';
  const _es = document.getElementById('endScreen'); if (_es) _es.style.display = 'none';
  
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  
  // Set canvas size
  const canvasContainer = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = canvasContainer.clientWidth;
  canvas.height = canvasContainer.clientHeight;
  
  isGameRunning = true;
  gameScore = 0;
  gameTime = 30;
  gameLives = 3;
  meteors = [];
  
  // Initialize player
  player = {
    x: canvas.width / 2,
    y: canvas.height - 50,
    width: 40,
    height: 40,
    speed: 5
  };
  
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: 0';
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = 'Time: 30s';
  document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = '❤️'.repeat(gameLives);
  
  // Enable controls
  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
  
  // Touch controls
  const leftBtn = document.getElementById('leftBtn');
  const rightBtn = document.getElementById('rightBtn');
  
  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = true; });
  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = false; });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = true; });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = false; });
  
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveLeft = true);
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveLeft = false);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveRight = true);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveRight = false);
  
  // Spawn meteors
  spawnInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    spawnMeteor();
  }, 800);
  
  // Game timer
  gameInterval = setInterval(() => {
    gameTime--;
    document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = 'Time: ' + gameTime + 's';
    
    if (gameTime <= 0) {
      endGame();
    }
  }, 1000);
  
  // Start game loop
  gameLoop();
}

function handleKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
    keys.left = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
    keys.right = true;
  }
  
  // Prevent scrolling
  if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
}

function handleKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
    keys.left = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
    keys.right = false;
  }
}

function spawnMeteor() {
  const size = Math.random() * 20 + 15;
  meteors.push({
    x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
    y: -size,
    width: size,
    height: size,
    speed: Math.random() * 3 + 2,
    rotation: 0,
    rotationSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
  });
}

function drawEmojiSprite(emoji, x, y, sizePx) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  ctx.font = sizePx + 'px "Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(emoji, x, y);
  ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  // Clear canvas
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'#0a0818'); bg.addColorStop(1,'#1a1530');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  // Draw stars background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const x = (Math.sin(Date.now() / 1000 + i) * 0.5 + 0.5) * canvas.width;
    const y = (Math.cos(Date.now() / 1000 + i * 2) * 0.5 + 0.5) * canvas.height;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, 2);
  }
  
  // Update player position
  if (keys.left || moveLeft) {
    player.x -= player.speed;
  }
  if (keys.right || moveRight) {
    player.x += player.speed;
  }
  
  // Keep player in bounds
  player.x = Math.max(player.width / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - player.width / 2, player.x));
  
  // Draw player
  drawEmojiSprite('🚀', player.x, player.y, player.width);
  
  // Update and draw meteors
  meteors.forEach((meteor, index) => {
    meteor.y += meteor.speed;
    meteor.rotation += meteor.rotationSpeed;
    
    drawEmojiSprite('☄️', meteor.x + meteor.width / 2, meteor.y + meteor.height / 2, meteor.width);

    // Check collision
    if (isColliding(player, meteor)) {
      meteors.splice(index, 1);
      gameLives--;
      document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
      if (gameLives <= 0) {
        endGame();
        return;
      }
    }
    
    // Remove if off screen
    if (meteor.y > canvas.height + meteor.height) {
      meteors.splice(index, 1);
      gameScore += 10;
      document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
    }
  });
  
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function isColliding(player, meteor) {
  const playerLeft = player.x - player.width / 2;
  const playerRight = player.x + player.width / 2;
  const playerTop = player.y - player.height / 2;
  const playerBottom = player.y + player.height / 2;
  
  const meteorLeft = meteor.x;
  const meteorRight = meteor.x + meteor.width;
  const meteorTop = meteor.y;
  const meteorBottom = meteor.y + meteor.height;
  
  return !(playerRight < meteorLeft || 
           playerLeft > meteorRight || 
           playerBottom < meteorTop || 
           playerTop > meteorBottom);
}

function endGame() {
  isGameRunning = false;
  clearInterval(gameInterval);
  clearInterval(spawnInterval);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);

  document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);

  const endScreen = document.getElementById('endScreen');
  const endTitle = document.getElementById('endTitle');
  const endStats = document.getElementById('endStats');
  if (gameTime <= 0) {
    endTitle.textContent = '🎉 You Survived!';
    endStats.textContent = 'Final score: ' + gameScore;
  } else {
    endTitle.textContent = '💥 Game Over!';
    endStats.textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
  }
  if (endScreen) endScreen.style.display = 'block';
}

/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
      "clip-path": clip,
      "pointer-events": "none",
    }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts: facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08,
    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('mercury', mercuryFacts, '🪨 Mercury');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Mercury Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Mercury Explained

Learn more about the smallest planet!

🌡️ Why is Mercury So Hot and Cold?

Mercury has no atmosphere - that means there's no air to trap heat like on Earth. During the day, the Sun heats up the surface quickly. At night, all that heat escapes into space because there's nothing to hold it in!

This is why Mercury has such extreme temperature changes between day and night.

💡 Fun Fact

Mercury's temperature can change by 600°C in a single day!

🔄 Strange Days and Years

Mercury has a very strange day and year cycle. One day on Mercury (sunrise to sunrise) takes 59 Earth days. But one year (orbit around the Sun) only takes 88 Earth days!

This means Mercury's day is longer than its year! If you lived on Mercury, you'd have birthdays more often than you'd have bedtimes!

🕳️ Mercury's Surface

Mercury looks a lot like our Moon. It's covered in craters from space rocks hitting it billions of years ago. The biggest crater is called Caloris Basin - it's huge!

There are also smooth plains called "maria" (seas in Latin), but they're made of hardened lava, not water. Mercury has no liquid water at all!

❄️ Ice on Mercury?

Even though Mercury is super hot, scientists have found ice in some craters near the poles! These craters are always in shadow, so the Sun never shines there.

The ice has been there for billions of years, protected from the Sun's heat!

💡 Fun Fact

Mercury might have more ice than our Moon!

🔭 Exploring Mercury

Scientists have sent spacecraft to study Mercury:

  • MARINER 10 - First spacecraft to visit Mercury in 1974
  • MESSENGER - Orbited Mercury from 2011 to 2015
  • BepiColombo - Arrived in 2025, still studying it

These missions help us learn more about this mysterious little planet!

🏋️ Gravity on Mercury

Mercury is much smaller than Earth, so its gravity is weaker too. If you weigh 30 kg on Earth, you would only weigh about 11 kg on Mercury!

You could jump much higher and lift much heavier things on Mercury!

💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - Mercury Quiz</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),

<body class="reading-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ Mercury Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="playerScore">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="vs-divider">VS</div>
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="botIcon">🪨</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="botName">Hermes</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What is special about Mercury's day and year?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">A day is longer than a year</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">A year is longer than a day</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">They are the same length</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Mercury has no days</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. How long is a year on Mercury?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">365 Earth days</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">180 Earth days</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">88 Earth days</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">24 Earth days</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. Why is Mercury not the hottest planet?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">It's too far from the Sun</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">It has no atmosphere to trap heat</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">It's always night there</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">It's made of ice</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. What covers Mercury's surface?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">Craters</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Oceans</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Mountains</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Forests</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. Does Mercury have moons?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Yes, 2 moons</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Yes, 1 moon</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Yes, 10 moons</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">No moons</div>

    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="score-card" id="scoreCard">
    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🪨</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">Hermes</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="message" id="scoreMessage"></div>

      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'Hermes';
  const botCharacter = '🪨';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>
