let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'Gaia';
  const botCharacter = '🌍';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.contentHtml:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - Mars</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:24px 16px 40px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:20px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:32px;
      color:#e27b58;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .mars-display{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:center;
      margin:30px 0;
    }
    .mars{
      width:110px;
      height:110px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,
        #d4a574 0%,
        #c9a86c 20%,
        #b8865a 40%,
        #a67c52 60%,
        #8b6914 80%,
        #6b4423 100%
      );
      border-radius:50%;
      box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(226,123,88,0.4),inset -15px -15px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:transform 0.3s;
      animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
      position:relative;
    }
    .mars::before{
      content:'';
      position:absolute;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 70%,rgba(139,105,20,0.4) 0%,transparent 50%);
      border-radius:50%;
    }
    .mars:hover{
      transform:scale(1.1);
    }
    @keyframes float{
      0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}
      50%{transform:translateY(-8px);}
    }
    .card{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:20px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .card h2{
      color:#e27b58;
      margin-bottom:12px;
      font-size:20px;
    }
    .card p{
      font-size:16px;
      line-height:1.7;
      margin-bottom:10px;
    }
    .fact-box{
      background:rgba(251,191,36,0.2);
      border-left:6px solid #fbbf24;
      padding:16px;
      border-radius:12px;
      margin-top:12px;
    }
    .fact-box h3{
      color:#fbbf24;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      font-size:18px;
    }
    .fact-box p{
      font-size:15px;
      line-height:1.6;
      margin:0;
    }
    .stats-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
      gap:12px;
      margin-top:12px;
    }
    .stat-item{
      background:rgba(226,123,88,0.1);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:14px;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .stat-label{
      font-size:13px;
      color:#c4b5fd;
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .stat-value{
      font-size:18px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#e27b58;
    }
    .nav-hint{
      margin-top:20px;
      text-align:center;
      font-size:13px;
      color:#a78bfa;
      background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
      padding:10px;
      border-radius:10px;
    }
    .planet-game{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:20px;
      margin-top:20px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .planet-game h2{
      color:#e67e5e;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      font-size:20px;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .planet-game p{
      text-align:center;
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:14px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
    }
    
    .game-hud-float{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;right:8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;flex-wrap:wrap;}
    .game-hud-float span{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.65);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);}
    .game-canvas{position:relative;}

    .game-canvas{position:relative;width:100%;height:280px;min-height:220px;max-height:280px;
      background:rgba(226,123,88,0.2);
      border-radius:16px;
      overflow:hidden;
      border:2px solid rgba(226,123,88,0.3);
      touch-action:none;
    }
    canvas{
      display:block;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
    }
    .touch-controls{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(3,60px);
      grid-template-rows:repeat(3,60px);
      gap:8px;
      justify-content:center;
      margin-top:12px;
    }
    .touch-btn{
      width:60px;
      height:60px;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border:2px solid rgba(226,123,88,0.3);
      color:#fff;
      font-size:24px;
      cursor:pointer;
      user-select:none;
      -webkit-user-select:none;
      transition:background 0.2s;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
    }
    .touch-btn:active{
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }
    .touch-btn:hover{
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    }
    .touch-btn.empty{
      visibility:hidden;
    }
    .game-score{
      text-align:center;
      font-size:20px;
      color:#e67e5e;
      font-weight:bold;
      margin-top:16px;
    }
    .game-timer{
      text-align:center;
      font-size:16px;
      color:#c4b5fd;
      margin-top:8px;
    }
    .start-game-btn{
      display:block;
      margin:16px auto 0;
      padding:12px 24px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e27b58,#b85c3d);
      color:#fff;
      font-size:16px;
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:0.2s;
    }
    .start-game-btn:hover{
      transform:scale(1.05);
    }
  
    .planet-svg-panel{background:#12102a;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(226,123,88,0.45);padding:12px;margin:20px 0;}
    .svg-viewport{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;max-height:min(72vw,260px);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0820;touch-action:none;}
    .svg-viewport svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;cursor:grab;}
    .planet-info-panel{margin-top:10px;min-height:52px;padding:12px 14px;background:#1a1735;border-radius:12px;border-left:4px solid #e27b58;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;}
    .planet-info-panel strong{color:#e27b58;font-size:15px;}
    .svg-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:10px;}
    .svg-ctrl{padding:10px 14px;border:none;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;}
    .svg-ctrl.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#ef4444);}
    .game-desc{text-align:center;color:#c4b5fd;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.55;padding:0 8px;}
    .game-overlay{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:rgba(8,6,24,0.94);padding:22px 26px;border-radius:16px;text-align:center;border:2px solid #e27b58;z-index:10;min-width:220px;max-width:90%;}
    .game-overlay h3{color:#ffd700;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:20px;}
    .game-overlay p{color:#ddd;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;}
    .overlay-btn{padding:10px 26px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;}
    .game-hud{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;}
    .game-hud-item{background:#1a1735;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;color:#e27b58;border:1px solid rgba(226,123,88,0.45);}
    .game-canvas{position:relative;}

function drawStarfield() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#050414');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#12102a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.12 + (i % 5) * 0.12) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc((i * 131) % canvas.width, (i * 73) % canvas.height, 0.8 + (i % 3), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}
function formatHudTimeLives() {
  return '⏱ ' + gameTime + 's | ' + '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
}
function updateMarsHud() {
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  document.getElementById('gameEnergy').textContent = '⛽ ' + Math.round(gameFuel) + '%';
}
function startHudTimer() {
  if (typeof hudTimer !== 'undefined' && hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  hudTimer = setInterval(function() {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    gameTime--;
    const el = document.getElementById('gameTimer');
    if (el) el.textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    updateMarsHud();
    if (gameTime <= 0) endGame();
  }, 1000);
}
function loseLife() {
  gameLives--;
  updateMarsHud();
  if (gameLives <= 0) endGame();
}

// Mars Rover Explorer Game - Canvas-based exploration
let gameSamples = 0;
let gameFuel = 100;
let animationFrame;
let isGameRunning = false;
let canvas, ctx;
let rover;
let rocks = [];
let obstacles = [];
let keys = {};
let moveUp = false;
let moveDown = false;
let moveLeft = false;
let moveRight = false;
let gameTime = 90;
let gameLives = 3;
let hudTimer;
let marsControlsBound = false;
let hitCooldown = 0;

function resetMarsControls() {
  keys = {};
  moveUp = moveDown = moveLeft = moveRight = false;
}

function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  resetMarsControls();
  const _ss = document.getElementById('startScreen'); if (_ss) _ss.style.display = 'none';
  const _es = document.getElementById('endScreen'); if (_es) _es.style.display = 'none';

  canvas.height = canvasContainer.clientHeight;

  };

      width: 20,
      height: 20,
      collected: false
    });

      x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - 60) + 30,
      y: Math.random() * (canvas.height - 60) + 30,
      size: 34,
      active: true
    });

  startHudTimer();
  
  if (!marsControlsBound) {
    marsControlsBound = true;
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    document.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    const upBtn = document.getElementById('upBtn');
    const downBtn = document.getElementById('downBtn');

    downBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveDown = false; });
    leftBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (isGameRunning) moveLeft = true; });
    leftBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = false; });
    rightBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (isGameRunning) moveRight = true; });
    rightBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = false; });
    upBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { if (isGameRunning) moveUp = true; });
    upBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { moveUp = false; });
    upBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { moveUp = false; });
    downBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { if (isGameRunning) moveDown = true; });
    downBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { moveDown = false; });
    downBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { moveDown = false; });
    leftBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { if (isGameRunning) moveLeft = true; });
    leftBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { moveLeft = false; });
    leftBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { moveLeft = false; });
    rightBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { if (isGameRunning) moveRight = true; });
    rightBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { moveRight = false; });
    rightBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { moveRight = false; });
    window.addEventListener('blur', resetMarsControls);
  }
  
  gameLoop();
}

function handleKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') {
    keys.up = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') {
    keys.down = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
    keys.left = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
    keys.right = true;
  }
  
  // Prevent scrolling
  if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
}

function handleKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') {
    keys.up = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') {
    keys.down = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
    keys.left = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
    keys.right = false;
  }
}

function drawMarsCrater(cx, cy, r) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r * 0.2, cy - r * 0.2, r * 0.1, cx, cy, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#3d2817');
  g.addColorStop(0.6, '#8B4513');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#C1440E');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,30,20,0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawFireObstacle(x, y, size) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.font = size + 'px "Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji",sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('🔥', x, y);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRover(x, y, facingRight) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  if (!facingRight) ctx.scale(-1, 1);
  ctx.font = '38px "Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji",sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillText('🚙', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnergyBar() {
  const barY = canvas.height - 16;
  const barW = canvas.width - 24;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(12, barY, barW, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = gameFuel > 25 ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171';
  ctx.fillRect(12, barY, barW * (gameFuel / 100), 10);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(12, barY, barW, 10);
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  // Clear canvas
  drawStarfield();
  
  // Draw Mars terrain with improved graphics
  // Base terrain gradient
  const terrainGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  terrainGradient.addColorStop(0, '#8B4513');
  terrainGradient.addColorStop(0.3, '#C1440E');
  terrainGradient.addColorStop(0.7, '#D2691E');
  terrainGradient.addColorStop(1, '#A0522D');
  ctx.fillStyle = terrainGradient;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  
  for (let c = 0; c < 6; c++) {
    drawMarsCrater((c * 97 + 40) % canvas.width, (c * 53 + 80) % (canvas.height - 40) + 20, 18 + (c % 3) * 8);
  }

  // Add terrain texture/dunes
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.3)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const duneX = (i * canvas.width / 7) + Math.sin(Date.now() / 2000 + i) * 15;
    const duneY = canvas.height - 100 + Math.cos(Date.now() / 3000 + i) * 20;
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(duneX, duneY, 60 + i * 10, 30 + i * 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  
  // Add small rocks scattered on terrain
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(105, 105, 105, 0.4)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const rockX = (i * canvas.width / 20) + Math.sin(i * 2) * 30;
    const rockY = canvas.height - 50 + Math.cos(i * 3) * 40;
    const rockSize = 3 + Math.random() * 5;
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rockX, rockY, rockSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  
  // Add dust particles
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(193, 154, 107, 0.2)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    const dustX = Math.random() * canvas.width;
    const dustY = Math.random() * canvas.height;
    const dustSize = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(dustX, dustY, dustSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  
  if (hitCooldown > 0) hitCooldown--;
  
  // Update rover position
  let moved = false;
  if (keys.up || moveUp) {
    rover.y -= rover.speed;
    moved = true;
  }
  if (keys.down || moveDown) {
    rover.y += rover.speed;
    moved = true;
  }
  if (keys.left || moveLeft) {
    rover.x -= rover.speed;
    rover.facingRight = true;
    moved = true;
  }
  if (keys.right || moveRight) {
    rover.x += rover.speed;
    rover.facingRight = false;
    moved = true;
  }
  
  // Keep rover in bounds
  rover.x = Math.max(rover.width / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - rover.width / 2, rover.x));
  rover.y = Math.max(rover.height / 2, Math.min(canvas.height - rover.height / 2, rover.y));
  
  // Consume fuel when moving (gentle drain)
  if (moved) {
    gameFuel -= 0.02;
    if (gameFuel <= 0) {
      loseLife();
      if (!isGameRunning) return;
      gameFuel = 100;
      hitCooldown = 60;
    }
    updateMarsHud();
  }
  
  // Fire hazards — one hit = one life, fire disappears
  obstacles.forEach(obstacle => {
    if (!obstacle.active || hitCooldown > 0) return;
    const ox = obstacle.x;
    const oy = obstacle.y;
    const hitR = obstacle.size * 0.45 + rover.width / 2;
    if (Math.hypot(rover.x - ox, rover.y - oy) < hitR) {
      obstacle.active = false;
      loseLife();
      if (!isGameRunning) return;
      hitCooldown = 90;
      rover.x = canvas.width / 2;
      rover.y = canvas.height / 2;
      updateMarsHud();
    }
  });
  
  // Draw rocks
  rocks.forEach(rock => {
    if (!rock.collected) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#696969';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(rock.x, rock.y, rock.width / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      
      // Rock texture
      ctx.fillStyle = '#808080';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(rock.x - 3, rock.y - 3, rock.width / 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      
      // Check collection
      const dx = rover.x - rock.x;
      const dy = rover.y - rock.y;
      const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      
      if (distance < rover.width / 2 + rock.width / 2) {
        rock.collected = true;
        gameSamples++;
        document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Samples: ' + gameSamples;
        
        if (gameSamples >= 8) {
          endGame();
          return;
        }
      }
    }
  });
  
  obstacles.forEach(obstacle => {
    if (obstacle.active) drawFireObstacle(obstacle.x, obstacle.y, obstacle.size);
  });
  
  drawRover(rover.x, rover.y, rover.facingRight);
  drawEnergyBar();
  
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function endGame() {
  isGameRunning = false;
  resetMarsControls();
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  const endScreen = document.getElementById('endScreen');
  const endTitle = document.getElementById('endTitle');
  const endStats = document.getElementById('endStats');
  if (endTitle) {
    if (gameSamples >= 8) endTitle.textContent = '🎉 Mission Complete!';
    else if (gameTime <= 0) endTitle.textContent = '⏱ Time Up!';
    else if (gameLives <= 0) endTitle.textContent = '💥 Game Over!';
    else endTitle.textContent = '🔴 Out of Fuel!';
  }
  if (endStats) endStats.textContent = 'Samples: ' + gameSamples + ' | Energy: ' + Math.round(gameFuel) + '%';
  if (endScreen) endScreen.style.display = 'flex';
}
/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
      "clip-path": clip,
      "pointer-events": "none",
    }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts: facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08,
    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('mars', marsFacts, '🔴 Mars');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Mars Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Mars Explained

Learn more about the red planet!

🔴 Why is Mars Red?

Mars is red because its soil contains a lot of iron oxide - that's the same thing as rust! When iron gets rusty, it turns red or orange.

Billions of years ago, Mars had water, which reacted with iron in the rocks to create rust. Now the whole planet looks red!

💡 Fun Fact

Mars's red color comes from rust - just like old rusty metal!

🏔️ Olympus Mons - The Giant Volcano

Olympus Mons is the largest volcano in the entire solar system! It's about 22 km (14 miles) tall - that's almost 3 times taller than Mount Everest!

It's also huge in width - about 600 km (373 miles) across. That's about the size of France! The volcano is so big because Mars doesn't have plate tectonics, so lava kept piling up in the same spot for billions of years.

🏞️ Valles Marineris - The Grand Canyon of Mars

Valles Marineris is a massive canyon system on Mars. It's over 4,000 km (2,500 miles) long - that's longer than the entire United States is wide!

The canyon is up to 7 km (4 miles) deep in some places. It would take the Grand Canyon and make it look tiny!

💨 Dust Storms

Mars has huge dust storms that can cover the entire planet! These storms can last for weeks or even months.

The dust is very fine - like flour. When winds blow, the dust gets everywhere and can block sunlight from reaching the surface.

💡 Fun Fact

Sometimes Mars dust storms are so big they can be seen from Earth with telescopes!

🌊 Water on Mars

Scientists believe Mars had liquid water billions of years ago. There are dried-up riverbeds, lakes, and even possible ocean shorelines on Mars!

Today, water exists as ice at the poles and possibly underground. Some rovers have found minerals that only form in water, proving Mars was once wet!

🤖 Mars Exploration

Humans have sent many robots to explore Mars:

  • Sojourner - First rover (1997)
  • Spirit & Opportunity - Rovers that lasted years longer than expected
  • Curiosity - Still exploring since 2012
  • Perseverance - Looking for signs of ancient life (2021)
  • Ingenuity - First helicopter to fly on another planet!

🚀 Could Humans Live on Mars?

Many people dream of sending humans to Mars! It would be very hard because:

  • There's no air to breathe
  • It's very cold
  • There's harmful radiation
  • The gravity is weak

But scientists are working on ways to overcome these challenges. Maybe one day, humans will live on Mars!

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:12px 16px 20px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container {
        padding: 10px 12px 16px;
      }
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:24px;
      color:#e27b58;
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .player-info{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:8px;
      margin-top:6px;
      font-size:16px;
      color:#ffd700;
      font-weight:bold;
    }
    .player-info span:first-child{
      font-size:24px;
    }
    .competition-bar{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:space-between;
      align-items:center;
      background:#1a1735;
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:10px;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    .competition-bar.hidden{display:none;}
    .competitor{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      gap:4px;
    }
    .competitor-icon{font-size:28px;}
    .competitor-name{font-size:12px;color:#c4b5fd;}
    .competitor-score{font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffd700;}
    .vs-divider{font-size:18px;color:#a78bfa;font-weight:bold;}
    .quiz-card{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:12px;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display:none;
    }
    .quiz-card.active{
      display:block;
    }
    .question{
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:bold;
      margin-bottom:10px;
      color:#fff;
    }
    .options{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:6px;
    }

      border-radius:8px;
      cursor:pointer;
      font-size:14px;
      transition:0.2s;
    }
    .option:hover{
      background:#1a1735;
      border-color:#ffd700;
    }
    .option.correct{
      background:rgba(34,197,94,0.3);
      border-color:#22c55e;
    }
    .option.wrong{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,0.3);
      border-color:#ef4444;
    }
    .feedback{
      margin-top:8px;
      padding:8px;
      border-radius:8px;
      font-size:13px;
      display:none;
    }
    .feedback.show{
      display:block;
    }
    .feedback.correct{
      background:rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
      color:#4ade80;
    }
    .feedback.wrong{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
      color:#f87171;
    }
    .score-card{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.98), rgba(255,165,0,0.98));
      border-radius:24px;
      padding:10px 20px 60px;
      text-align:center;
      margin-top:20px;
      display:none;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.35);
      border:4px solid #fff176;
      z-index: 10;
      position: relative;
    }
    .score-card.show{
      display:block;
      animation: slideUp 0.5s ease-out;
    }

      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(30px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
    .score-card h2{
      font-size:26px;
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom:30px;
      color:#1a1240;
      text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4);

    .score-display{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1240, #3a2f70);
      border-radius:18px;
      padding:18px;
      margin-bottom:18px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 20;
    }
    .score-card .score{
      font-size:52px;
      font-weight:bold;
      margin-bottom:6px;
      color:#ffe066;
      text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 224, 102, 0.7);
    }
    .score-label{

      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing:2px;
    }
    .score-card .message{
      font-size:17px;
      margin-top:10px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-weight:bold;
      padding:10px;
      background:#1a1240;
      border-radius:12px;
    }
    .podium{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:flex-end;
      gap:14px;
      margin-top:120px;
      height:140px;
      padding:6px;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    .podium-place{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      gap:4px;
      transition:transform 0.3s ease;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .podium-place:hover{
      transform:translateY(-1px);
    }
    .podium-character{
      font-size:42px;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3));
      animation: none;
    }
    .podium-bar{
      border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      font-size:22px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#fff;
      position:relative;
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }
    .podium-bar.first{
      width:100px;
      height:100px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b8860b,#8b6914);
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(184,134,11,0.45);
    }
    .podium-bar.second{
      width:90px;
      height:80px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#c0c0c0,#a0a0a0);
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 18px rgba(192,192,192,0.35);
    }
    .rank-badge{
      position:absolute;
      top:-10px;
      font-size:26px;
      animation: none;
    }
    .podium-name{
      font-size:13px;
      color:#1a1240;
      margin-top:6px;
      text-align:center;
      font-weight:bold;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      padding:5px 9px;
      border-radius:8px;
    }
    .podium-score{
      font-size:15px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-weight:bold;
      background:#1a1240;
      padding:3px 7px;
      border-radius:6px;
    }
    .button-group{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      justify-content:center;
      margin-top:20px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
    }
    .retry-btn{
      padding:14px 28px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:14px;
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:all 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }
    .retry-btn{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1240,#3a2f70);
      color:#ffe066;
    }
    .retry-btn:hover{
      transform:scale(1.06);
      box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    }
    
    
    /* Mobile adjustments */
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .score-card {
        padding:10px 14px 60px;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }
      .score-card h2 {

      }
      .score-card .score {

      }
      .score-display {
        padding: 9px;
      }

        margin-top: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        font-size: 14px;
        color:#ffffff;
        background:#1a1240;
      }
      .podium {
        height: 120px;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 6px;
        margin-top: 120px;
      }
      .podium-character {
        font-size: 36px;
      }
      .podium-bar.first {
        width: 85px;
        height: 90px;
        background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b8860b,#8b6914);
      }
      .podium-bar.second {
        width: 75px;
        height: 70px;
      }
      .rank-badge {
        font-size: 22px;
        top: -8px;
      }
      .button-group {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
      }
      .retry-btn {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
    }
    .nav-hint{
      margin-top:12px;
      text-align:center;
      font-size:11px;
      color:#a78bfa;
      background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
      padding:6px;
      border-radius:8px;
    }

<body class="reading-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ Mars Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="playerScore">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="vs-divider">VS</div>
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="botIcon">🔴</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="botName">Ares</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. Why is Mars red?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">It's made of fire</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">Iron oxide (rust) in the soil</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">It's very hot</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">It has red plants</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. What is the largest volcano in the solar system?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">Olympus Mons</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">Mount Everest</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">Mauna Loa</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">Mount Fuji</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. How many moons does Mars have?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">0</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">1</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">2</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">3</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. What is Valles Marineris?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">A huge canyon system</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">A mountain range</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">A large ocean</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">A city on Mars</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. What was the first helicopter to fly on another planet?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Curiosity</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Spirit</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Opportunity</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">Ingenuity</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="score-card" id="scoreCard">
    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🔴</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">Ares</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="message" id="scoreMessage"></div>
    <div class="button-group">
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'Ares';
  const botCharacter = '🔴';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const jupiterFacts = [
  "Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system!",
  "Jupiter has at least 95 moons!",
  "Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant storm!",
  "Jupiter spins faster than any other planet!",

];
let factIndex = 0;

function showJupiterFact() {

}

function checkFact(btn, isCorrect) {
  const result = document.getElementById('gameResult');
  if (isCorrect) {
    btn.classList.add('correct');
    result.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';

function drawStarfield() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#050414');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#12102a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.12 + (i % 5) * 0.12) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc((i * 131) % canvas.width, (i * 73) % canvas.height, 0.8 + (i % 3), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}
function formatHudTimeLives() {
  return '⏱ ' + gameTime + 's | ' + '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
}
function startHudTimer() {
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  hudTimer = setInterval(function() {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    gameTime--;
    const el = document.getElementById('gameTimer');
    if (el) el.textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    if (gameTime <= 0) endGame();
  }, 1000);
}
function loseLife() {
  gameLives--;
  const el = document.getElementById('gameTimer');
  if (el) el.textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  if (gameLives <= 0) endGame();
}

// Storm Escape Game - Canvas-based vertical scroller
let gameScore = 0;
let gameTime = 30;
let gameLives = 3;
let hudTimer;
let gameInterval;
let spawnInterval;
let animationFrame;
let isGameRunning = false;
let canvas, ctx;
let player;
let storms = [];
let keys = {};
let moveUp = false;
let moveDown = false;

function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  const _ss = document.getElementById('startScreen'); if (_ss) _ss.style.display = 'none';
  const _es = document.getElementById('endScreen'); if (_es) _es.style.display = 'none';
  
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  
  // Set canvas size
  const canvasContainer = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = canvasContainer.clientWidth;
  canvas.height = canvasContainer.clientHeight;
  
  isGameRunning = true;
  gameScore = 0;
  gameTime = 30;
  gameLives = 3;
  storms = [];
  
  // Initialize player
  player = {
    x: 50,
    y: canvas.height / 2,
    width: 40,
    height: 40,
    speed: 5
  };
  
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: 0';
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  startHudTimer();
  
  // Enable controls
  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
  
  // Touch controls
  const upBtn = document.getElementById('upBtn');
  const downBtn = document.getElementById('downBtn');
  
  upBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveUp = true; });
  upBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveUp = false; });
  downBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveDown = true; });
  downBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveDown = false; });
  
  upBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveUp = true);
  upBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveUp = false);
  downBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveDown = true);
  downBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveDown = false);
  
  // Spawn storms
  spawnInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    spawnStorm();
  }, 600);
  
  // Start game loop
  gameLoop();
}

function handleKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') {
    keys.up = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') {
    keys.down = true;
  }
  
  // Prevent scrolling
  if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
}

function handleKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') {
    keys.up = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') {
    keys.down = false;
  }
}

function spawnStorm() {
  const size = Math.random() * 40 + 30;
  storms.push({
    x: canvas.width + size,
    y: Math.random() * (canvas.height - size),
    width: size,
    height: size * 0.7,
    speed: Math.random() * 3 + 3,
    rotation: 0
  });
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  // Clear canvas
  drawStarfield();
  
  // Update player position
  if (keys.up || moveUp) {
    player.y -= player.speed;
  }
  if (keys.down || moveDown) {
    player.y += player.speed;
  }
  
  // Keep player in bounds
  player.y = Math.max(player.height / 2, Math.min(canvas.height - player.height / 2, player.y));
  
  // Draw player (rocket) with improved graphics
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);
  
  // Rocket body with gradient
  const bodyGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(-15, 0, 20, 0);
  bodyGradient.addColorStop(0, '#E8B87A');
  bodyGradient.addColorStop(0.3, '#d4a574');
  bodyGradient.addColorStop(0.7, '#c9a846');
  bodyGradient.addColorStop(1, '#b8865a');
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient;
  
  // Main rocket body (elongated)
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(25, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-15, -12);
  ctx.lineTo(-15, 12);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Rocket nose cone
  const noseGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(15, 0, 25, 0);
  noseGradient.addColorStop(0, '#FF6B6B');
  noseGradient.addColorStop(1, '#FF4444');
  ctx.fillStyle = noseGradient;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(25, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(15, -8);
  ctx.lineTo(15, 8);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Cockpit window
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1E3A5A';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(5, 0, 8, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Window glass
  ctx.fillStyle = '#87CEEB';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(5, 0, 6, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Window shine
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(3, -2, 2, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Rocket fins
  ctx.fillStyle = '#b8865a';
  // Top fin
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-15, -12);
  ctx.lineTo(-25, -20);
  ctx.lineTo(-15, -5);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Bottom fin
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-15, 12);
  ctx.lineTo(-25, 20);
  ctx.lineTo(-15, 5);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Engine exhaust with glow
  ctx.shadowColor = '#FF6B35';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  
  // Engine flame
  const flameGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(-15, 0, -35, 0);
  flameGradient.addColorStop(0, '#FFD700');
  flameGradient.addColorStop(0.3, '#FF6B35');
  flameGradient.addColorStop(0.7, '#FF4500');
  flameGradient.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle = flameGradient;
  
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-15, -8);
  ctx.lineTo(-35 - Math.random() * 10, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-15, 8);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  
  // Engine glow ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-15, 0, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  
  ctx.restore();
  
  // Update and draw storms
  storms.forEach((storm, index) => {
    storm.x -= storm.speed;
    storm.rotation += 0.02;
    
    // Draw storm cloud
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(storm.x + storm.width / 2, storm.y + storm.height / 2);
    ctx.rotate(storm.rotation);
    
    // Storm cloud body
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.8)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, storm.width / 2, storm.height / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    // Storm cloud detail
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(101, 67, 33, 0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-storm.width / 4, -storm.height / 4, storm.width / 4, storm.height / 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    ctx.restore();
    
    // Check collision
    if (isColliding(player, storm)) {
      storms.splice(index, 1);
      gameScore -= 5;
      loseLife();
      document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
    }
    
    // Remove if off screen
    if (storm.x + storm.width < 0) {
      storms.splice(index, 1);
      gameScore += 10;
      document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
    }
  });
  
  // Draw Jupiter background effect
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.3)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(
      canvas.width + (Date.now() / 50 + i * 200) % (canvas.width + 200) - 100,
      canvas.height / 2 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 1000 + i) * 50,
      100 + i * 30,
      0,
      Math.PI * 2
    );
    ctx.fill();
  }
  
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function isColliding(player, storm) {
  const playerLeft = player.x - player.width / 2;
  const playerRight = player.x + player.width / 2;
  const playerTop = player.y - player.height / 2;
  const playerBottom = player.y + player.height / 2;
  
  const stormLeft = storm.x;
  const stormRight = storm.x + storm.width;
  const stormTop = storm.y;
  const stormBottom = storm.y + storm.height;
  
  return !(playerRight < stormLeft || 
           playerLeft > stormRight || 
           playerBottom < stormTop || 
           playerTop > stormBottom);
}

function endGame() {
  isGameRunning = false;
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  clearInterval(gameInterval);
  clearInterval(spawnInterval);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
  const endScreen = document.getElementById('endScreen');
  const endTitle = document.getElementById('endTitle');
  const endStats = document.getElementById('endStats');
  if (endTitle) endTitle.textContent = '🎉 Game Over!';
  if (endStats) endStats.textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
  if (endScreen) endScreen.style.display = 'block';
}
/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),

    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",

      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
