    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('jupiter', jupiterFacts, '🟠 Jupiter');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Jupiter Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Jupiter Explained

Learn more about the giant planet!

💨 Gas Giant

Jupiter is a gas giant, which means it doesn't have a solid surface like Earth. It's made mostly of hydrogen (about 90%) and helium (about 10%).

As you go deeper into Jupiter, the gas gets thicker and turns into a liquid. Scientists think there might be a solid core at the very center, but we're not sure!

💡 Fun Fact

Jupiter is almost entirely made of the same gases as the Sun!

🌀 The Great Red Spot

The Great Red Spot is a giant storm that's been raging for at least 400 years! It was first seen by astronomers in the 1600s.

The storm is about 1.3 times wider than Earth. Winds in the storm can reach 643 km/h (400 mph) - that's faster than any hurricane on Earth!

🌙 The Galilean Moons

Jupiter's four largest moons were discovered by Galileo Galilei in 1610. They're called the Galilean moons:

  • Io - The most volcanically active place in the solar system
  • Europa - Has an icy shell with a possible ocean underneath
  • Ganymede - The largest moon in the solar system (bigger than Mercury!)
  • Callisto - The most heavily cratered object in the solar system

🔄 Fast Spinner

Jupiter spins very fast - a day is only about 10 hours long! This makes Jupiter bulge at the middle, like a squashed ball.

The equator is about 7,000 km wider than the poles! This fast spinning also creates strong jet streams and colorful bands in Jupiter's atmosphere.

🛡️ Jupiter as a Shield

Jupiter's strong gravity acts like a cosmic shield. It pulls in comets and asteroids that might otherwise hit the inner planets, including Earth.

Without Jupiter, Earth might get hit by dangerous space rocks much more often. Jupiter is like a big brother protecting us!

💡 Fun Fact

Jupiter has a faint ring system, but it's much smaller than Saturn's rings!

🔭 Exploring Jupiter

Many spacecraft have visited Jupiter:

  • Pioneer 10 & 11 - First spacecraft to fly by Jupiter (1973)
  • Voyager 1 & 2 - Took amazing photos of Jupiter (1979)
  • Galileo - First spacecraft to orbit Jupiter (1995-2003)
  • Jun - Currently studying Jupiter (arrived 2016)

<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ Jupiter Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What is Jupiter mostly made of?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Rock and metal</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">Hydrogen and helium</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Water and ice</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Oxygen and nitrogen</div>

    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. How many Earths could fit inside Jupiter?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">100</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">500</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">Over 1,300</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">10,000</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. What is the Great Red Spot?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">A giant storm</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">A large mountain</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">A volcano</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">An ocean</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">

    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Io</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Europa</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">Ganymede</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Callisto</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. How long is a day on Jupiter?</div>
    <div class="options">

    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>

      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🟠</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">JupiterBot</div>
      </div>

        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>

<div class="nav-hint">

  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'JupiterBot';
  const botCharacter = '🟠';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

  <title>Solar System Adventure - Saturn</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;

    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:24px 16px 40px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:20px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:32px;
      color:#f4d59e;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .ringShip-display{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:center;
      margin:30px 0;
    }
    .ringShip-container{
      position:relative;
      width:180px;
      height:140px;
      cursor:pointer;
    }
    .ring{
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;
      left:50%;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      width:180px;
      height:55px;
      border:12px solid rgba(244,213,158,0.7);
      border-radius:50%;
      animation:rotate 20s linear infinite;
      box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(244,213,158,0.3);
      z-index:1;
    }
    .ringShip{
      width:100px;
      height:100px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,
        #e8d4a8 0%,
        #d4b87a 10%,
        #c9a86c 20%,
        #d4b87a 30%,
        #e8d4a8 40%,
        #c9a86c 50%,
        #d4b87a 60%,
        #e8d4a8 70%,
        #c9a86c 80%,
        #d4b87a 90%,
        #b8865a 100%
      );
      border-radius:50%;
      box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(244,213,158,0.4),inset -15px -15px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;
      left:50%;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      animation:float 7s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:2;
    }
    .ring::before{
      content:'';
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;
      left:50%;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      width:155px;
      height:40px;
      border:8px solid rgba(212,184,122,0.6);
      border-radius:50%;
    }
    .ring::after{
      content:'';
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;
      left:50%;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      width:130px;
      height:28px;
      border:5px solid rgba(180,160,100,0.5);
      border-radius:50%;
    }
    .ringShip-container:hover .ringShip{
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1);
    }
    @keyframes float{
      0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateY(0);}
      50%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateY(-5px);}
    }
    @keyframes rotate{
      from{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0deg);}
      to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg);}
    }
    .card{
      background:#1a1735;

<script>
const saturnFacts = [
  "Saturn has the most moons of any planet - over 140!",
  "Saturn's rings are mostly made of ice!",
  "Saturn could float in water!",
  "Saturn has a hexagonal storm at its north pole!",
  "Saturn's moon Titan has lakes of methane!",
  "Saturn is the least dense planet!",
  "Saturn's rings are very young - only 100 million years old!",
  "Saturn spins so fast a day is only 10.7 hours!"
];
let factIndex = 0;

function showSaturnFact() {
  PlanetViewer.nextFact();
}

function checkFact(btn, isCorrect) {
  const result = document.getElementById('gameResult');
  if (isCorrect) {
    btn.classList.add('correct');
    result.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    result.style.color = '#4ade80';
  } else {
    btn.classList.add('wrong');
    result.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again!';
    result.style.color = '#f87171';
  }
}


// Moon Catch — dodge rocks, collect moons & ice from Saturn
let gameScore = 0, gameLives = 3, gameTime = 60, hudTimer;
let isGameRunning = false, canvas, ctx, animationFrame;
let player = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 44 };
let items = [], spawnTimer = 0, spawnEvery = 40;
let scorePopups = [], screenFlash = 0, collected = 0;
let dragPointerId = null, keys = {};
const WIN_SCORE = 120;

function formatHudTimeLives() {
  return '⏱ ' + gameTime + 's | ' + '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
}
function startHudTimer() {
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  hudTimer = setInterval(function() {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    gameTime--;
    document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    if (gameTime <= 0) endGame(gameScore >= WIN_SCORE);
  }, 1000);
}
function drawStarfield() {
  ctx.save();
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#050414'); g.addColorStop(1, '#12102a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.12 + (i % 4) * 0.08) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc((i * 131) % canvas.width, (i * 73) % canvas.height, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawEmojiSprite(emoji, x, y, sizePx) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  ctx.font = sizePx + 'px "Segoe UI Emoji", "Apple Color Emoji", "Noto Color Emoji", serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(emoji, x, y);
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawHitFlash() {
  if (screenFlash === 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = screenFlash > 0 ? screenFlash / 36 : (-screenFlash / 36);
  ctx.fillStyle = screenFlash > 0 ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  ctx.restore();
  screenFlash += screenFlash > 0 ? -1 : 1;
  if (Math.abs(screenFlash) <= 0) screenFlash = 0;
}
function bindSaturnDrag() {
  const box = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  if (!box || box._saturnDrag) return;
  box._saturnDrag = true;
  function moveTo(clientX) {
    if (!isGameRunning || !canvas) return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width) return;
    player.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * canvas.width;
    player.x = Math.max(28, Math.min(canvas.width - 28, player.x));
  }
  box.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e) {
    if (!isGameRunning || e.target.closest('.game-overlay')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    dragPointerId = e.pointerId;
    box.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    moveTo(e.clientX);
  });
  box.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e) {
    if (dragPointerId !== e.pointerId || !isGameRunning) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    moveTo(e.clientX);
  });
  function release(e) {
    if (dragPointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
    dragPointerId = null;
  }
  box.addEventListener('pointerup', release);
  box.addEventListener('pointercancel', release);
}
function spawnItem() {
  const roll = Math.random();
  let type, emoji, score, bad, r;
  if (roll < 0.14) {
    type = 'moon'; emoji = '🌕'; score = 20; bad = false; r = 18;
  } else if (roll < 0.48) {
    type = 'ice'; emoji = '💎'; score = 8; bad = false; r = 14;
  } else {
    type = 'rock'; emoji = '☄️'; score = 0; bad = true; r = 16;
  }
  items.push({
    x: 24 + Math.random() * (canvas.width - 48),
    y: -24,
    vy: 2.1 + Math.random() * 1.6 + (60 - gameTime) * 0.018,
    r: r,
    emoji: emoji,
    score: score,
    bad: bad,
    spin: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}
function updateGame() {
  if (keys.left) player.x -= 5.5;
  if (keys.right) player.x += 5.5;
  player.x = Math.max(28, Math.min(canvas.width - 28, player.x));

  spawnTimer++;
  spawnEvery = Math.max(20, 40 - Math.floor((60 - gameTime) / 6));
  if (spawnTimer >= spawnEvery) {
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnItem();
  }

  items.forEach(function(it) {
    it.y += it.vy;
    it.spin += 0.04;
  });
  items = items.filter(function(it) { return it.y < canvas.height + 36; });

  for (let i = items.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const it = items[i];
    if (Math.hypot(it.x - player.x, it.y - player.y) < it.r + 22) {
      if (it.bad) {
        gameLives--;
        screenFlash = -16;
        document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
        if (gameLives <= 0) { endGame(false); return; }
      } else {
        gameScore += it.score;
        collected++;
        document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
        scorePopups.push({ x: it.x, y: it.y, t: 40, text: '+' + it.score });
        screenFlash = 12;
        if (gameScore >= WIN_SCORE) { endGame(true); return; }
      }
      items.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}
function drawSaturnBanner() {
  ctx.save();
  const cx = canvas.width / 2, cy = 52;
  const pr = Math.min(canvas.width * 0.09, 30);
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.scale(1, 0.32);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(210,180,120,0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, pr * 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,140,0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, pr * 1.85, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  drawEmojiSprite('🪐', cx, cy, pr * 1.9);
}
function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  document.getElementById('startScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'none';
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const box = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = box.clientWidth; canvas.height = box.clientHeight;
  isGameRunning = true;
  gameScore = 0; gameLives = 3; gameTime = 60;
  items = []; spawnTimer = 0; spawnEvery = 40;
  scorePopups = []; screenFlash = 0; collected = 0;
  keys = {}; dragPointerId = null;
  player.x = canvas.width / 2;
  player.y = canvas.height - 46;
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: 0';
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  bindSaturnDrag();
  startHudTimer();
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
  gameLoop();
}
function onKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') { keys.left = true; e.preventDefault(); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') { keys.right = true; e.preventDefault(); }
}
function onKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = false;
}
function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  drawStarfield();
  drawHitFlash();
  drawSaturnBanner();

  items.forEach(function(it) {
    drawEmojiSprite(it.emoji, it.x, it.y, it.r * 1.55);
  });

  drawEmojiSprite('🛸', player.x, player.y, 34);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4d59e';
  ctx.font = '12px Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText('Goal: ' + WIN_SCORE + ' pts', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 12);
  ctx.restore();

  scorePopups.forEach(function(p) {
    p.t--;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.t / 40);
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + (16 + (40 - p.t) * 0.25) + 'px Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(p.text, p.x, p.y - (40 - p.t));
    ctx.restore();
  });
  scorePopups = scorePopups.filter(function(p) { return p.t > 0; });

  updateGame();
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}
function endGame(won) {
  isGameRunning = false;
  clearInterval(hudTimer);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
  dragPointerId = null;
  document.getElementById('endTitle').textContent = won ? '🏆 Saturn Explorer!' : '💫 Try Again!';
  document.getElementById('endStats').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore + ' | Caught: ' + collected + ' · Goal: ' + WIN_SCORE;
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'flex';
}

/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
      "clip-path": clip,
      "pointer-events": "none",
    }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts: facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08,
    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('saturn', saturnFacts, '💍 Saturn');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Saturn Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Saturn Explained

Learn more about the ringed planet!

💍 What Are Saturn's Rings Made Of?

Saturn's rings are made of billions of pieces of ice and rock. The pieces range from tiny dust grains to chunks as big as houses!

The rings are mostly water ice, with some rocky material mixed in. They're very thin - only about 10 meters to 1 km thick - but very wide!

💡 Fun Fact

If you made a model of Saturn's rings with a 1-meter ring, it would be thinner than a sheet of paper!

🎈 Why Saturn Could Float

Saturn is the only planet that would float in water! This is because it's less dense (lighter for its size) than water.

Saturn's average density is about 0.69 g/cm³, while water is 1.0 g/cm³. This means Saturn is lighter than water, so it would float if you had a big enough bathtub!

🌙 Titan - Saturn's Largest Moon

Titan is Saturn's biggest moon and the second-largest moon in the solar system. It's even bigger than Mercury!

Titan is special because:

  • It has a thick atmosphere (thicker than Earth's!)
  • It has liquid lakes on its surface (made of methane, not water)
  • It might have conditions suitable for life
  • It's the only moon with a substantial atmosphere

🌀 The Hexagonal Storm

Saturn has a mysterious hexagonal (six-sided) storm at its north pole. This storm has been there for at least decades and is about 30,000 km across.

Scientists aren't sure why the storm is hexagonal. It might be related to Saturn's fast rotation and the way winds move around the pole. It's one of Saturn's biggest mysteries!

🔭 Exploring Saturn

Many spacecraft have visited Saturn:

  • Pioneer 11 - First spacecraft to fly by Saturn (1979)
  • Voyager 1 & 2 - Took amazing photos of Saturn (1980-1981)
  • Cassini - Orbited Saturn for 13 years (2004-2017)
  • Huygens - Landed on Titan in 2005

⏳ Young Rings

Scientists used to think Saturn's rings were as old as the solar system (4.6 billion years). But new research shows they might be much younger - only about 100 million years old!

This means the dinosaurs might have seen Saturn without rings, or with different rings. The rings might have formed from a destroyed moon or comet!

<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ Saturn Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>

    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="botIcon">💍</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="botName">SaturnBot</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What are Saturn's rings made of?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Rock only</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">Ice and rock</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Gas</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Fire</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. Why could Saturn float in water?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">It's less dense than water</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">It's very light</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">It's hollow</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">It has air inside</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. What is Saturn's largest moon?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Rhea</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Enceladus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">Titan</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Mimas</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. What shape is the storm at Saturn's north pole?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Circle</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Triangle</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">Hexagon</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Square</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. How many moons does Saturn have?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">About 50</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">About 80</div>

    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">💍</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">SaturnBot</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>

<div class="nav-hint">

  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'SaturnBot';
  const botCharacter = '💍';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const uranusFacts = [

function drawStarfield() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#050414');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#12102a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.12 + (i % 5) * 0.12) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc((i * 131) % canvas.width, (i * 73) % canvas.height, 0.8 + (i % 3), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}
function formatHudTimeLives() {
  return '⏱ ' + gameTime + 's | ' + '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
}
function startHudTimer() {
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  hudTimer = setInterval(function() {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    gameTime--;
    const el = document.getElementById('gameTimer');
    if (el) el.textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    if (gameTime <= 0) endGame();
  }, 1000);
}
function loseLife() {
  gameLives--;
  const el = document.getElementById('gameTimer');
  if (el) el.textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  if (gameLives <= 0) endGame();
}

// Ice Maze Game - Procedural maze generation
let gameLevel = 1;
let gameMoves = 0;
let gameTime = 60;
let gameLives = 3;
let hudTimer;
let gameInterval;
let animationFrame;
let isGameRunning = false;
let canvas, ctx;
let maze = [];
let mazeWidth = 15;
let mazeHeight = 15;
let cellSize;
let player = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let goal = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let hazards = [];
let keys = {};
let moveUp = false;
let moveDown = false;
let moveLeft = false;
let moveRight = false;

function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  const _ss = document.getElementById('startScreen'); if (_ss) _ss.style.display = 'none';
  const _es = document.getElementById('endScreen'); if (_es) _es.style.display = 'none';
  
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  
  // Set canvas size
  const canvasContainer = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = canvasContainer.clientWidth;
  canvas.height = canvasContainer.clientHeight;
  
  isGameRunning = true;
  gameLevel = 1;
  gameMoves = 0;
  gameTime = 60;
  gameLives = 3;
  mazeWidth = 19;
  mazeHeight = 19;
  hazards = [];
  
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Level: 1';
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  startHudTimer();
  
  // Generate maze
  generateMaze();
  
  // Set player and goal positions
  player = { x: 1, y: 1 };
  goal = { x: mazeWidth - 2, y: mazeHeight - 2 };
  
  // Calculate cell size
  cellSize = Math.min(canvas.width / mazeWidth, canvas.height / mazeHeight);
  
  // Enable controls
  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
  
  // Touch controls
  const upBtn = document.getElementById('upBtn');
  const downBtn = document.getElementById('downBtn');
  const leftBtn = document.getElementById('leftBtn');
  const rightBtn = document.getElementById('rightBtn');
  
  upBtn.addEventListener('click', () => tryMove(0, -1));
  downBtn.addEventListener('click', () => tryMove(0, 1));
  leftBtn.addEventListener('click', () => tryMove(-1, 0));
  rightBtn.addEventListener('click', () => tryMove(1, 0));
  
  upBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); tryMove(0, -1); });
  downBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); tryMove(0, 1); });
  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); tryMove(-1, 0); });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); tryMove(1, 0); });
  
  // Spawn hazards
  spawnHazards();
  
  // Start game loop
  gameLoop();
}

function generateMaze() {
  // Initialize maze with walls
  maze = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < mazeHeight; y++) {
    maze[y] = [];
    for (let x = 0; x < mazeWidth; x++) {
      maze[y][x] = 1; // 1 = wall
    }
  }
  
  // Recursive backtracking maze generation
  function carve(x, y) {
    maze[y][x] = 0; // 0 = path
    
    const directions = [
      [0, -2], [0, 2], [-2, 0], [2, 0]
    ];
    
    // Shuffle directions
    for (let i = directions.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [directions[i], directions[j]] = [directions[j], directions[i]];
    }
    
    for (const [dx, dy] of directions) {
      const nx = x + dx;
      const ny = y + dy;
      
      if (nx > 0 && nx < mazeWidth - 1 && ny > 0 && ny < mazeHeight - 1 && maze[ny][nx] === 1) {
        maze[y + dy / 2][x + dx / 2] = 0;
        carve(nx, ny);
      }
    }
  }
  
  carve(1, 1);
  ensureStartExits();
  
  // Ensure goal is accessible
  maze[mazeHeight - 2][mazeWidth - 2] = 0;
}

function ensureStartExits() {
  maze[1][1] = 0;
  const open = [[1, 2], [2, 1], [1, 3], [3, 1], [2, 2]];
  open.forEach(([x, y]) => {
    if (x > 0 && x < mazeWidth - 1 && y > 0 && y < mazeHeight - 1) maze[y][x] = 0;
  });
}

function findCorridorCell() {
  const candidates = [];
  for (let y = 2; y < mazeHeight - 2; y++) {
    for (let x = 2; x < mazeWidth - 2; x++) {
      if (maze[y][x] !== 0) continue;
      if ((x === 1 && y === 1) || (x === goal.x && y === goal.y)) continue;
      let paths = 0;
      [[0, -1], [0, 1], [-1, 0], [1, 0]].forEach(([dx, dy]) => {
        if (maze[y + dy][x + dx] === 0) paths++;
      });
      if (paths === 2 && Math.abs(x - 1) + Math.abs(y - 1) > 5) {
        candidates.push({ x, y });
      }
    }
  }
  if (!candidates.length) return null;
  return candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
}

function spawnHazards() {
  hazards = [];
  if (gameLevel < 2) return;
  const spot = findCorridorCell();
  if (spot) {
    hazards.push({ x: spot.x, y: spot.y, static: true });
  }
}

function tryMove(dx, dy) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  const newX = player.x + dx;
  const newY = player.y + dy;
  if (newX < 0 || newX >= mazeWidth || newY < 0 || newY >= mazeHeight || maze[newY][newX] === 1) return;
  if (hazards.some(h => h.x === newX && h.y === newY)) return;
  player.x = newX;
  player.y = newY;
  gameMoves++;
  updateLivesDisplay();
  if (player.x === goal.x && player.y === goal.y) {
    nextLevel();
  }
}

function updateLivesDisplay() {
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
}

function handleKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning || e.repeat) return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') tryMove(0, -1);
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') tryMove(0, 1);
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') tryMove(-1, 0);
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') tryMove(1, 0);
  if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
}

function handleKeyUp(e) {}

function nextLevel() {
  if (gameLevel >= 3) {
    endGame();
    return;
  }
  gameLevel++;
  gameTime = 60; // Reset time for each level
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Level: ' + gameLevel;
  updateLivesDisplay();
  
  // Increase maze size
  if (gameLevel % 2 === 0) {
    mazeWidth += 2;
    mazeHeight += 2;
  }
  
  // Reset moves
  gameMoves = 0;
  
  // Generate new maze
  generateMaze();
  
  // Reset positions
  player = { x: 1, y: 1 };
  goal = { x: mazeWidth - 2, y: mazeHeight - 2 };
  
  // Recalculate cell size
  cellSize = Math.min(canvas.width / mazeWidth, canvas.height / mazeHeight);
  
  // Respawn hazards
  spawnHazards();
}

function drawEmojiSprite(emoji, x, y, sizePx) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  ctx.font = sizePx + 'px "Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(emoji, x, y);
  ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  // Clear canvas
  drawStarfield();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(125, 227, 244, 0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  
  // Calculate offset to center maze
  const mazePixelWidth = mazeWidth * cellSize;
  const mazePixelHeight = mazeHeight * cellSize;
  const offsetX = (canvas.width - mazePixelWidth) / 2;
  const offsetY = (canvas.height - mazePixelHeight) / 2;
  
  // Draw maze
  for (let y = 0; y < mazeHeight; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < mazeWidth; x++) {
      if (maze[y][x] === 1) {
        const wx = offsetX + x * cellSize, wy = offsetY + y * cellSize;
        const ice = ctx.createLinearGradient(wx, wy, wx + cellSize, wy + cellSize);
        ice.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(180,230,255,0.85)');
        ice.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100,180,220,0.75)');
        ctx.fillStyle = ice;
        ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, cellSize, cellSize);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(wx + 1, wy + 1, cellSize - 2, cellSize - 2);
      } else {
        // Path
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
        ctx.fillRect(offsetX + x * cellSize, offsetY + y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
      }
    }
  }
  
  const gx = offsetX + goal.x * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  const gy = offsetY + goal.y * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  drawEmojiSprite('🏁', gx, gy, cellSize * 0.92);

  const px = offsetX + player.x * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  const py = offsetY + player.y * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  drawEmojiSprite('👩‍🚀', px, py, cellSize * 0.95);

  hazards.forEach(hazard => {
    const hx = offsetX + hazard.x * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    const hy = offsetY + hazard.y * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    drawEmojiSprite('👽', hx, hy, cellSize * 0.82);
  });
  
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function endGame() {
  isGameRunning = false;
  clearInterval(hudTimer);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
  const _es = document.getElementById('endScreen');
  if (_es) {
    _es.style.display = 'flex';
    const t = document.getElementById('endTitle');
    const s = document.getElementById('endStats');
    if (t) {
      if (gameLives <= 0) t.textContent = '👾 Aliens Win!';
      else if (gameTime <= 0) t.textContent = '⏱ Time Up!';
      else if (gameLevel >= 3) t.textContent = '🏆 Ice Maze Master!';
      else t.textContent = '🎉 Keep Exploring!';
    }
    if (s) s.textContent = 'Level: ' + gameLevel + ' | Moves: ' + gameMoves + ' | Lives: ' + gameLives;
  }
}

/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
      "clip-path": clip,
      "pointer-events": "none",
    }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts: facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08,
    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('uranus', uranusFacts, '🔵 Uranus');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),

        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),

    .container{

      padding:20px 18px 36px;

    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:22px;

    h1{

    .select-stage{
      display:grid;
      gap:20px;
      margin-bottom:18px;

      min-width:0;

      margin-bottom:12px;

 input[type="text"]{

        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, rgba(167,139,250,0.16), transparent 58%),

    .preview-badge{

      padding:5px 12px;

    .preview-character{
      font-size:clamp(64px, 14vw, 96px);
      margin-bottom:10px;
      line-height:1;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(255,193,7,0.35));
    }
    .preview-name{
      font-size:clamp(20px, 3.5vw, 28px);
      color:#ffd700;
      font-weight:bold;
      text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,0.35);
    }
    .msg{
      margin-top:6px;
      background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(251,191,36,0.16), rgba(251,191,36,0.08));
      border-left:6px solid #fbbf24;
      padding:14px 16px;
      border-radius:14px;
      font-size:clamp(14px, 2.4vw, 16px);
      line-height:1.6;

    .nav-hint{
      margin-top:14px;

      border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.22);

    .nav-hint div + div{
      margin-top:6px;
    }
    @media (min-width: 720px), (orientation: landscape) and (min-width: 640px) {
      .select-stage{
        grid-template-columns:minmax(260px, 340px) minmax(0, 1fr);

        text-align:left;
      }
      .character-grid{
        gap:14px;

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container{padding:14px 12px 24px;}

      .character-option{
        min-height:82px;
        padding:10px 4px 8px;
        border-width:2px;
        border-radius:14px;
      }
    }
    body.character-select-page{
      overflow-x:hidden !important;
      overflow-y:auto !important;

    body.character-select-page .container{
      height:auto !important;

    body.character-select-page:has(.character-grid) input[type="text"]{
      padding:14px 16px !important;
      margin-bottom:0 !important;
      font-size:17px !important;
    }
    body.character-select-page:has(.character-grid) .character-grid{
      gap:12px !important;
      margin-bottom:0 !important;
    }
    body.character-select-page:has(.character-grid) .character-option{
      padding:14px 8px 12px !important;

    body.character-select-page:has(.character-grid) .character-name{
      font-size:clamp(11px, 2.4vw, 14px) !important;
      margin-top:0 !important;
    }
    body.character-select-page:has(.character-grid) .msg{
      margin-top:6px !important;
      padding:14px 16px !important;
      font-size:clamp(14px, 2.4vw, 16px) !important;
    }
    body.character-select-page:has(.character-grid) .nav-hint{
      margin-top:14px !important;
      padding:12px 14px !important;
      font-size:clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 14px) !important;
    }
    @media (max-height: 760px) {
      body.character-select-page:has(.character-grid) .preview-character{
        font-size:clamp(56px, 12vw, 80px) !important;
      }
      body.character-select-page:has(.character-grid) .character-option{
        min-height:88px;
      }
    }
  /* solar-desktop-fit */
html {
  min-height: 100%;
}
body:has(.character-grid),
body:has(.game-shell),
body:has(#solarSvg),
body:has(.fire-btn),
body:has(.planet-game) {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0 !important;

  overflow-x: hidden;

  box-sizing: border-box;
}
body:has(.character-grid) .container,
body:has(.game-shell) .container,
body:has(#solarSvg) .container,
body:has(.fire-btn) .container,
body:has(.planet-game) .container {
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;

  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;

steps.title: Uranus Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Uranus Explained

Learn more about the ice giant!

❄️ What is an Ice Giant?

Uranus is called an "ice giant" because it's made mostly of water, ammonia, and methane ices. This is different from gas giants like Jupiter and Saturn, which are made mostly of hydrogen and helium.

Underneath the icy layer, Uranus probably has a rocky core about the size of Earth!

💡 Fun Fact

Uranus is the coldest planet in the solar system, even colder than Neptune!

🔄 The Extreme Tilt

Uranus has the most extreme tilt of any planet - it rotates at about 98 degrees! This means it essentially rolls on its side as it orbits the Sun.

Because of this tilt, Uranus has very strange seasons. Each pole gets 42 years of continuous sunlight followed by 42 years of darkness!

🎨 The Blue Color

Uranus's beautiful blue-green color comes from methane in its atmosphere. Methane absorbs red light from the Sun and reflects blue light, making the planet appear blue.

The upper atmosphere of Uranus is the coldest place in the solar system, at about -224°C (-371°F)!

🌙 Shakespearean Moons

Uranus's 27 moons are named after characters from plays by William Shakespeare and poems by Alexander Pope. This is different from other planets, whose moons are usually named after gods and goddesses.

The five largest moons are:

  • Miranda - Has strange terrain with huge canyons
  • Ariel - The brightest of Uranus's moons
  • Umbriel - The darkest of Uranus's moons
  • Titania - The largest moon
  • Oberon - The outermost large moon

🔭 Discovery of Uranus

Uranus was the first planet discovered with a telescope! It was found by William Herschel in 1781. Before that, people thought it was just a star!

Herschel originally wanted to name it "Georgium Sidus" (George's Star) after King George III of England, but other astronomers preferred the name Uranus, after the Greek god of the sky.

💍 Dark Rings

Uranus has 13 rings that were discovered in 1977. Unlike Saturn's bright, icy rings, Uranus's rings are dark and made of dust and small rocks.

The rings are very thin - only about 10 meters to 100 meters thick. They're also very young, probably formed from broken-up moons or comets.
