      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What type of planet is Uranus?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Gas giant</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">Ice giant</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Rocky planet</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Dwarf planet</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. What makes Uranus's color blue?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">Oxygen</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">Nitrogen</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">Methane</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">Carbon dioxide</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. How is Uranus's axis tilted?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">23 degrees</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">45 degrees</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">67 degrees</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">About 98 degrees</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. How many moons does Uranus have?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">13</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">20</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">27</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">50</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. When was Uranus discovered?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">1600s</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">1781</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">1900s</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">2000s</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="score-card" id="scoreCard">
    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🔵</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">UranusBot</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="message" id="scoreMessage"></div>
    <div class="button-group">
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'UranusBot';
  const botCharacter = '🔵';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const neptuneFacts = [
  "Neptune was discovered through mathematics!",
  "Neptune has the strongest winds in the solar system!",
  "Neptune takes 165 Earth years to orbit the Sun!",
  "Neptune's moon Triton orbits backwards!",
  "Neptune has 16 moons!",
  "Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun!",
  "Neptune was discovered in 1846!",
  "Neptune has a Great Dark Spot storm!"
];
let factIndex = 0;

function showNeptuneFact() {

}

function checkFact(btn, isCorrect) {
  const result = document.getElementById('gameResult');
  if (isCorrect) {
    btn.classList.add('correct');
    result.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    result.style.color = '#4ade80';

// Storm Pop — tap storms before they grow
let gameScore = 0, gameLives = 3, gameTime = 90, hudTimer, spawnTimer;
let isGameRunning = false, canvas, ctx, animationFrame;
let storms = [];

function formatHudTimeLives() {
  return '⏱ ' + gameTime + 's | ' + '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
}
function startHudTimer() {
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  hudTimer = setInterval(function() {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    gameTime--;
    document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    if (gameTime <= 0) endGame();
  }, 1000);
}
function drawStarfield() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#050414'); g.addColorStop(1, '#0a1840');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
}
function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  document.getElementById('startScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'none';
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const box = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = box.clientWidth; canvas.height = box.clientHeight;
  isGameRunning = true; gameScore = 0; gameLives = 3; gameTime = 90; storms = [];
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Storms: 0';
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  startHudTimer();
  spawnTimer = setInterval(spawnStorm, 1100);
  canvas.onclick = onTap;
  canvas.ontouchstart = function(e) { e.preventDefault(); onTap(e.touches[0]); };
  gameLoop();
}
function spawnStorm() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  storms.push({
    x: 40 + Math.random() * (canvas.width - 80),
    y: 40 + Math.random() * (canvas.height - 80),
    r: 8, maxR: 28 + Math.random() * 18, grow: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.1
  });
}
function onTap(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
  const ty = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);
  for (let i = storms.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = storms[i];
    if (Math.hypot(tx - s.x, ty - s.y) < s.r + 8) {
      storms.splice(i, 1);
      gameScore++;
      document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Storms: ' + gameScore;
      if (gameScore >= 20) endGame(true);
      return;
    }
  }
}
function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  drawStarfield();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(75,112,221,0.25)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  storms.forEach((s, i) => {
    s.r += s.grow;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 2, s.x, s.y, s.r);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#5c6bc0'); g.addColorStop(1, '#283593');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.font = (s.r * 0.9) + 'px serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('🌪️', s.x, s.y);
    if (s.r >= s.maxR) {
      storms.splice(i, 1);
      gameLives--;
      document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
      if (gameLives <= 0) endGame(false);
    }
  });
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}
function endGame(won) {
  isGameRunning = false;
  clearInterval(hudTimer); clearInterval(spawnTimer);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  canvas.onclick = null;
  document.getElementById('endTitle').textContent = won ? '🏆 Storm Tamer!' : '💨 Storms Win!';
  document.getElementById('endStats').textContent = 'Storms popped: ' + gameScore;
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'flex';
}

/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
      "clip-path": clip,
      "pointer-events": "none",
    }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts: facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08,
    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('neptune', neptuneFacts, '🔷 Neptune');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Neptune Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Neptune Explained

Learn more about the windy planet!

🧮 Mathematical Discovery

Neptune is the only planet discovered through mathematical prediction! In the 1840s, astronomers noticed that Uranus wasn't moving the way it should.

Two mathematicians, Urbain Le Verrier and John Couch Adams, calculated that another planet must be pulling on Uranus. In 1846, astronomers looked where they predicted - and found Neptune!

💡 Fun Fact

Neptune was found within 1 degree of where the math said it would be!

💨 Supersonic Winds

Neptune has the fastest winds in the solar system, reaching speeds of 2,100 km/h (1,300 mph). That's faster than the speed of sound on Earth!

These winds create huge storms in Neptune's atmosphere. The most famous is the Great Dark Spot, a storm similar to Jupiter's Great Red Spot. However, Neptune's storms come and go more quickly.

🌙 Triton - The Strange Moon

Neptune's largest moon, Triton, is very unusual. It orbits Neptune backwards (retrograde orbit), which means it moves in the opposite direction of Neptune's rotation.

Scientists think Triton was once a dwarf planet that Neptune captured billions of years ago. Triton is slowly getting closer to Neptune and will eventually crash into it or break apart!

❄️ Ice Giant Structure

Like Uranus, Neptune is an ice giant. It has three main layers:

  • Atmosphere - Made of hydrogen, helium, and methane
  • Mantle - Made of water, ammonia, and methane ices
  • Core - Rocky core about the size of Earth

The methane in Neptune's atmosphere gives it its beautiful blue color, just like Uranus.

🔭 Exploring Neptune

Only one spacecraft has ever visited Neptune - Voyager 2 in 1989. It flew by Neptune and took amazing photos of the planet and its moons.

Voyager 2 discovered Neptune's rings, six new moons, and the Great Dark Spot. No other spacecraft has visited Neptune since, but scientists hope to send more missions in the future!

🌡️ Cold and Distant

Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun, so it's very cold and receives very little sunlight. A year on Neptune is 165 Earth years - that's a long time to wait for your birthday!

Despite being so far, Neptune still has weather and seasons, just like Earth. But each season lasts for over 40 Earth years!

  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'NeptuneBot';
  const botCharacter = '🔷';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

<body class="big-planet-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>☄️ Meteors</h1>
    <div class="subtitle">Shooting stars in the sky!</div>
  </div>

  <div class="planet-svg-panel">
    <div class="svg-viewport" id="svgViewport">
      <svg id="planetSvg" viewBox="0 0 400 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-label="Meteor">
        <defs><clipPath id="globe"><circle r="88"/></clipPath></defs>
        <g id="planetGroup"></g>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="planet-info-panel" id="planetInfo"><strong>☄️ Meteor</strong><br>Watch it spin! Use the buttons below to zoom and rotate.</div>
    <div class="svg-controls">
      <button class="svg-ctrl" id="btnSpin" type="button">Stop</button>
      <button class="svg-ctrl" id="btnZoomIn" type="button">🔍 +</button>
      <button class="svg-ctrl" id="btnZoomOut" type="button">🔍 −</button>
      <button class="svg-ctrl" id="btnRotL" type="button">↺</button>
      <button class="svg-ctrl" id="btnRotR" type="button">↻</button>
    </div>
  </div>
    <p class="scroll-cue">↓ Scroll for facts and the mini-game</p>

  <div class="card">
    <h2>🌟 What is a Meteor?</h2>
    <p>A meteor is a streak of light you see when a space rock burns up in Earth's atmosphere. Kids often call them shooting stars!</p>
    <p>Before it enters the air, the rock is called a meteoroid. If a piece survives and lands on the ground, it becomes a meteorite.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h2>🔥 Burning Bright</h2>
    <p>Meteors glow because friction heats them up. They can travel up to 70 km per second — that's super fast!</p>
    <div class="fact-box">
      <h3>💡 Fun Fact</h3>
      <p>Most meteors are tiny — about the size of a grain of sand!</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h2>📏 Meteor Stats</h2>
    <div class="stats-grid">
      <div class="stat-item"><div class="stat-label">Typical speed</div><div class="stat-value">Up to 70 km/s</div></div>
      <div class="stat-item"><div class="stat-label">Daily hits</div><div class="stat-value">Millions!</div></div>
      <div class="stat-item"><div class="stat-label">Meteor showers</div><div class="stat-value">From comet dust</div></div>
      <div class="stat-item"><div class="stat-label">Bright ones</div><div class="stat-value">Fireballs</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h2>🌠 Meteor Showers</h2>
    <p>Sometimes Earth passes through a trail of dust left by a comet. Then we see many meteors in one night — a meteor shower!</p>
    <p>Famous showers include the Perseids in August and the Geminids in December. Grab a blanket and look up!</p>
  </div>

  <div class="planet-game">
    <h2>🛡️ Meteor Shield!</h2>
    <p class="game-desc">Meteors fall from the sky! TAP each one to destroy it before it hits the ground.</p>
    <div class="game-canvas" id="gameCanvas">
      <canvas id="gameCanvasElement"></canvas>
      <div class="game-overlay" id="startScreen">
        <h3>🛡️ Meteor Shield!</h3>
        <p>TAP falling meteors to protect the planet. Don't let them hit the ground!</p>
        <button class="overlay-btn" type="button" onclick="startGame()">▶️ Start</button>
      </div>
      <div class="game-overlay end-popup" id="endScreen" style="display:none;">
        <h3 id="endTitle">🎉 Great job!</h3>
        <p id="endStats">Score: 0</p>
        <button class="overlay-btn" type="button" onclick="startGame()">🔄 Play Again</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
const meteorFacts = [
  "Most meteors are smaller than a grain of sand!",
  "A meteoroid becomes a meteor when it burns in the sky!",
  "Meteor showers happen when Earth hits comet dust!",
  "Fireballs are extra-bright meteors!",
  "Meteorites are meteors that land on Earth!",
  "The Perseids happen every August!",
  "Meteors can travel 70 km per second!",
  "Ancient people made wishes on shooting stars!"
];

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',
  el(tag, a) { const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag); for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); return e; },
  svgRoot(g) { return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById('planetSvg'); },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector('#' + id)) return 'url(#' + id + ')';
    let defs = svg.querySelector('defs'); if (!defs) { defs = this.el('defs', {}); svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild); }
    const cp = this.el('clipPath', { id }); cp.appendChild(this.el('circle', { r: String(r) })); defs.appendChild(cp);
    return 'url(#' + id + ')';
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector('#sphereShade')) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector('defs'); if (!defs) { defs = this.el('defs', {}); svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild); }
    const rg = this.el('radialGradient', { id: 'sphereShade', cx: '35%', cy: '32%', r: '65%' });
    rg.appendChild(this.el('stop', { offset: '0%', 'stop-color': '#ffffff', 'stop-opacity': '0.22' }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el('stop', { offset: '100%', 'stop-color': '#000000', 'stop-opacity': '0.45' }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureMeteorGrad(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector('#meteorGrad')) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector('defs'); if (!defs) { defs = this.el('defs', {}); svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild); }
    const rg = this.el('radialGradient', { id: 'meteorGrad', cx: '35%', cy: '30%', r: '65%' });
    rg.appendChild(this.el('stop', { offset: '0%', 'stop-color': '#fcd34d' }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el('stop', { offset: '50%', 'stop-color': '#b45309' }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el('stop', { offset: '100%', 'stop-color': '#78350f' }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  drawMeteor(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const t = S.el('text', {
      x: '0', y: '16', 'text-anchor': 'middle',
      'font-size': '220',
      'pointer-events': 'none'
    });
    t.textContent = '☄️';
    g.appendChild(t);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88; const S = this; const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, 'globe', r) : '';
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === 'meteor') { S.drawMeteor(g, r, clip, svg); return; }
    g.appendChild(S.el('circle', { r: String(r), fill: '#888' }));
  }
};

function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08, dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg'); this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup'); this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
S.spin = true;
      const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => { S.spin = !S.spin; btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin'; btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin); };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => { S.dragging = true; S.dragMoved = false; const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e; S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX; S.startY = p.clientY; };
      const onMove = e => { if (!S.dragging) return; const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e; if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true; S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; };
      const onUp = e => { if (!S.dragging) return; if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; } };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown); window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove); window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', onDown, { passive: true }); this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, { passive: true }); this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.018; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }; this.draw(); loop();
    },
    draw() { while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild); this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')'); StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88); }
  };
}
const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('meteor', meteorFacts, '☄️ Meteor');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

let canvas, ctx, isGameRunning = false, gameScore = 0, gameTime = 60, gameLives = 3;
let meteors = [], spawnInterval, hudTimer, animationFrame, groundY;

function drawStarfield() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#050414'); g.addColorStop(1, '#12102a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.15 + (i % 4) * 0.1) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc((i * 127) % canvas.width, (i * 83) % canvas.height, 0.8 + (i % 2), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawHud() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, 36);
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px Comic Sans MS'; ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
  ctx.fillText('⭐ ' + gameScore, 12, 24);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillStyle = '#c4b5fd';
  ctx.fillText('⏱ ' + gameTime + 's', canvas.width / 2, 24);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.fillStyle = '#f87171';
  ctx.fillText('❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives)), canvas.width - 12, 24);
}

function spawnMeteor() {
  meteors.push({ x: 30 + Math.random() * (canvas.width - 60), y: -20, r: 22 + Math.random() * 8, speed: 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.45, tail: Math.random() * Math.PI });
}

function drawMeteor(m) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.font = (m.r * 1.6) + 'px "Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji",sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('☄️', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
}

function handleTap(clientX, clientY) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = (clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
  const y = (clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);
  for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = meteors[i];
    if (Math.hypot(x - m.x, y - m.y) < m.r + 18) {
      meteors.splice(i, 1); gameScore += 10;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,215,0,0.8)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      return;
    }
  }
}

function loseLife() {
  gameLives--;
  if (gameLives <= 0) endGame(false);
}

function endGame(won) {
  isGameRunning = false;
  clearInterval(spawnInterval); clearInterval(hudTimer);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  const title = document.getElementById('endTitle');
  if (gameLives <= 0) title.textContent = '💥 Meteors Hit Ground!';
  else if (won || gameScore >= 30) title.textContent = '🏆 Shield Hero!';
  else if (gameTime <= 0) title.textContent = '⏱ Time Up!';
  else title.textContent = '🎉 Nice Try!';
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('endStats').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore + ' | Lives left: ' + gameLives;
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  drawStarfield();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,80,40,0.25)'; ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, canvas.width, canvas.height - groundY);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ade80'; ctx.fillRect(0, groundY - 4, canvas.width, 4);
  meteors.forEach((m, i) => {
    m.y += m.speed;
    drawMeteor(m);
    if (m.y + m.r >= groundY) { meteors.splice(i, 1); loseLife(); }
  });
  drawHud();
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  document.getElementById('startScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'none';
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const box = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = box.clientWidth; canvas.height = box.clientHeight;
  groundY = canvas.height - 40;
  isGameRunning = true; gameScore = 0; gameTime = 60; gameLives = 3; meteors = [];
  spawnInterval = setInterval(spawnMeteor, 950);
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  hudTimer = setInterval(() => { if (!isGameRunning) return; gameTime--; if (gameTime <= 0) endGame(gameScore >= 30); }, 1000);
  canvas.onclick = e => handleTap(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  canvas.ontouchstart = e => { e.preventDefault(); handleTap(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY); };
  gameLoop();
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Meteor Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Meteors Explained

Learn about shooting stars!

🪨 Three Names for Space Rocks

Scientists use three words for the same kind of object at different stages:

  • Meteoroid — A rock floating in space
  • Meteor — The bright streak when it burns in the sky
  • Meteorite — A piece that survives and lands on Earth

💡 Fun Fact

About 44 tons of space dust and tiny rocks hit Earth every day — most are too small to see!

🔥 Why They Glow

When a meteoroid slams into air at incredible speed, friction heats it until it glows. The air around it gets super hot too — that's the bright trail you see!

Most meteoroids burn up completely before reaching the ground. Only the toughest rocks become meteorites.

🌠 Meteor Showers

Comets leave trails of dust behind them as they orbit the Sun. When Earth's orbit crosses that dust trail, we get a meteor shower — dozens of meteors per hour!

Each shower is named after the constellation they seem to come from, like the Perseids (from Perseus) or Leonids (from Leo).

💥 Big Impacts

Sometimes a very large meteoroid hits Earth. About 66 million years ago, a huge impact may have helped end the age of dinosaurs!

Meteor Crater in Arizona is a famous hole made by a meteorite about 50,000 years ago. It is almost 1.2 km wide!

🔭 Watching the Sky

The best time to see meteors is on a dark, moonless night away from city lights. Lie back, let your eyes adjust, and look at the whole sky.

You don't need a telescope — meteors move too fast! Just patience and a cozy blanket.

<script>
const blackHoleFacts = [
  "Black holes aren't holes — they're super dense objects!",
  "Not even light can escape past the event horizon!",
  "Our Milky Way has a supermassive black hole at its center!",
  "Black holes can merge and make bigger black holes!",
  "The first black hole photo was taken in 2019!",

  "Some black holes shoot jets of energy into space!",

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',
  el(tag, a) { const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag); for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); return e; },

  },

  },
  ensureBhGlow(svg) {

    const rg = this.el('radialGradient', { id: 'bhGlow', cx: '50%', cy: '50%', r: '50%' });

    ring.appendChild(S.el('ellipse', { rx: String(r * 1.72), ry: String(r * 0.44), fill: 'none', stroke: 'rgba(251,146,60,0.95)', 'stroke-width': '15' }));
    ring.appendChild(S.el('ellipse', { rx: String(r * 1.52), ry: String(r * 0.36), fill: 'none', stroke: 'rgba(251,191,36,0.45)', 'stroke-width': '5' }));
    g.appendChild(ring);
    g.appendChild(S.el('circle', { cx: '46', cy: '-20', r: '15', fill: 'rgba(253,224,71,0.9)', 'pointer-events': 'none' }));
    g.appendChild(S.el('circle', { r: String(r * 1.12), fill: 'url(#bhGlow)', 'pointer-events': 'none' }));
    g.appendChild(S.el('circle', { r: String(r * 0.56), fill: '#000000' }));
    g.appendChild(S.el('circle', { r: String(r), fill: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.001)', 'pointer-events': 'all', style: 'cursor:pointer' }));

    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, 'globe', r) : '';
    if (type === 'blackhole') { S.drawBlackHole(g, r, clip, svg); return; }
    g.appendChild(S.el('circle', { r: String(r), fill: '#222' }));
  }
};

function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08, dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg'); this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup'); this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
S.spin = true;
      const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => { S.spin = !S.spin; btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin'; btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin); };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => { S.dragging = true; S.dragMoved = false; const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e; S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX; S.startY = p.clientY; };
      const onMove = e => { if (!S.dragging) return; const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e; if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true; S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; };
      const onUp = e => { if (!S.dragging) return; const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e; if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact(); if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; } };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown); window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove); window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', onDown, { passive: true }); this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, { passive: true }); this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.022; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      S.spin = true;
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(cx, cy) { const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint(); pt.x = cx; pt.y = cy; const m = this.g.getScreenCTM(); if (!m) return false; const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse()); return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88; },
    nextFact() { this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length; this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi]; },
    draw() { while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild); this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')'); StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88); }

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('blackhole', blackHoleFacts, '🕳️ Black Hole');
function initBlackHoleViewer() {
  try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }
}
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initBlackHoleViewer);
} else {
  initBlackHoleViewer();
}

let canvas, ctx, isGameRunning = false, gameScore = 0, gameTime = 60, gameLives = 3;
let cx = 0, cy = 0, holeR = 0, pullStrength = 0.34;
let player = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let bodies = [], spawnTimer = 0, spawnEvery = 46;
let scorePopups = [], screenFlash = 0, rescued = 0;
let hudTimer, animationFrame, dragPointerId = null, keys = {};
const WIN_SCORE = 100;

function formatHudTimeLives() {
  return '⏱ ' + gameTime + 's | ' + '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
}
function drawStarfield() {
  ctx.save();
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#050414'); g.addColorStop(1, '#12102a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.12 + (i % 5) * 0.1) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc((i * 113) % canvas.width, (i * 67) % canvas.height, 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawEmojiSprite(emoji, x, y, sizePx) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  ctx.font = sizePx + 'px "Segoe UI Emoji", "Apple Color Emoji", "Noto Color Emoji", serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(emoji, x, y);
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawHitFlash() {
  if (screenFlash === 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = screenFlash > 0 ? screenFlash / 36 : (-screenFlash / 36);
  ctx.fillStyle = screenFlash > 0 ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  ctx.restore();
  screenFlash += screenFlash > 0 ? -1 : 1;
  if (Math.abs(screenFlash) <= 0) screenFlash = 0;
}
function drawBlackHoleCore() {
  ctx.save();
  const disk = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, holeR * 0.4, cx, cy, holeR * 2.8);
  disk.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
  disk.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(55,25,95,0.85)');
  disk.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(167,139,250,0.45)');
  disk.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = disk;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, holeR * 2.8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(251,146,60,0.55)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, holeR * 1.7, holeR * 0.42, -0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, holeR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
function bindBhDrag() {
  const box = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  if (!box || box._bhDrag) return;
  box._bhDrag = true;
  function moveTo(clientX, clientY) {
    if (!isGameRunning || !canvas) return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;
    player.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * canvas.width;
    player.y = ((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * canvas.height;
    player.x = Math.max(24, Math.min(canvas.width - 24, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(42, Math.min(canvas.height - 24, player.y));
  }
  box.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e) {
    if (!isGameRunning || e.target.closest('.game-overlay')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    dragPointerId = e.pointerId;
    box.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    moveTo(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  });
  box.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e) {
    if (dragPointerId !== e.pointerId || !isGameRunning) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    moveTo(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  });
  function release(e) {
    if (dragPointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
    dragPointerId = null;
  }
  box.addEventListener('pointerup', release);
  box.addEventListener('pointercancel', release);
}
function spawnAtEdge() {
  const pad = 18;
  const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
  let x, y;
  if (edge === 0) { x = pad + Math.random() * (canvas.width - pad * 2); y = pad; }
  else if (edge === 1) { x = canvas.width - pad; y = pad + Math.random() * (canvas.height - pad * 2); }
  else if (edge === 2) { x = pad + Math.random() * (canvas.width - pad * 2); y = canvas.height - pad; }
  else { x = pad; y = pad + Math.random() * (canvas.height - pad * 2); }
  const roll = Math.random();
  let emoji, score, bad, r;
  if (roll < 0.42) { emoji = '⭐'; score = 15; bad = false; r = 16; }
  else if (roll < 0.68) { emoji = '📡'; score = 8; bad = false; r = 14; }
  else { emoji = '☄️'; score = 0; bad = true; r = 15; }
  bodies.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: 0, vy: 0, emoji: emoji, score: score, bad: bad, r: r });
}
function updateGame() {
  if (keys.left) player.x -= 5.5;
  if (keys.right) player.x += 5.5;
  if (keys.up) player.y -= 5.5;
  if (keys.down) player.y += 5.5;
  player.x = Math.max(24, Math.min(canvas.width - 24, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(42, Math.min(canvas.height - 24, player.y));

  spawnTimer++;
  spawnEvery = Math.max(22, 46 - Math.floor((60 - gameTime) / 5));
  pullStrength = 0.34 + (60 - gameTime) * 0.004;
  if (spawnTimer >= spawnEvery) {
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnAtEdge();
  }

  for (let i = bodies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bodies[i];
    const dx = cx - b.x;
    const dy = cy - b.y;
    const dist = Math.max(holeR + 8, Math.hypot(dx, dy));
    const pull = pullStrength * (140 / dist);
    b.vx += (dx / dist) * pull;
    b.vy += (dy / dist) * pull;
    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;

    if (Math.hypot(b.x - player.x, b.y - player.y) < b.r + 22) {
      if (b.bad) {
        gameLives--;
        screenFlash = -16;
        document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
        if (gameLives <= 0) { endGame(false); return; }
      } else {
        gameScore += b.score;
        rescued++;
        document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
        scorePopups.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y, t: 40, text: '+' + b.score });
        screenFlash = 12;
        if (gameScore >= WIN_SCORE) { endGame(true); return; }
      }
      bodies.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    if (dist < holeR + 6) {
      bodies.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}
function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  drawStarfield();
  drawHitFlash();
  drawBlackHoleCore();

  bodies.forEach(function(b) {
    drawEmojiSprite(b.emoji, b.x, b.y, b.r * 1.55);
  });
  drawEmojiSprite('🛸', player.x, player.y, 34);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c4b5fd';
  ctx.font = '12px Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Rescue ' + WIN_SCORE + ' pts before time runs out!', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 12);
  ctx.restore();

  scorePopups.forEach(function(p) {
    p.t--;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.t / 40);
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + (16 + (40 - p.t) * 0.25) + 'px Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(p.text, p.x, p.y - (40 - p.t));
    ctx.restore();
  });
  scorePopups = scorePopups.filter(function(p) { return p.t > 0; });

  updateGame();
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}
function onKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') { keys.left = true; e.preventDefault(); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') { keys.right = true; e.preventDefault(); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') { keys.up = true; e.preventDefault(); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') { keys.down = true; e.preventDefault(); }
}
function onKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') keys.up = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') keys.down = false;
}
function startGame() {
  document.getElementById('startScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'none';
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const box = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = box.clientWidth; canvas.height = box.clientHeight;
  cx = canvas.width / 2; cy = canvas.height / 2;
  holeR = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.11;
  isGameRunning = true;
  gameScore = 0; gameTime = 60; gameLives = 3;
  bodies = []; spawnTimer = 0; spawnEvery = 46;
  scorePopups = []; screenFlash = 0; rescued = 0;
  keys = {}; dragPointerId = null; pullStrength = 0.34;
  player.x = canvas.width / 2;
  player.y = canvas.height - 42;
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: 0';
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  bindBhDrag();
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  hudTimer = setInterval(function() {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    gameTime--;
    document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    if (gameTime <= 0) endGame(gameScore >= WIN_SCORE);
  }, 1000);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
  gameLoop();
}
function endGame(won) {
  isGameRunning = false;
  clearInterval(hudTimer);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
  dragPointerId = null;
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('endTitle').textContent = won ? '🏆 Gravity Hero!' : '💫 Swallowed by Gravity!';
  document.getElementById('endStats').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore + ' | Rescued: ' + rescued + ' · Goal: ' + WIN_SCORE;
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Black Hole Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Black Holes Explained

Gravity's ultimate mystery!

⚫ How Black Holes Form

When a very massive star runs out of fuel, its core can collapse under its own gravity. If the star is big enough, it squeezes into an incredibly small, dense point called a singularity.

All that mass packed into a tiny space creates gravity so strong that nothing can escape if it gets too close.

💡 Fun Fact

A black hole the mass of the Sun would be only about 6 km across — smaller than a city!

🌀 Event Horizon & Accretion Disk

The event horizon is the boundary where escape becomes impossible. Think of it as the "edge" of the black hole — but it's not a solid surface!

Gas and dust spiraling inward often form a glowing accretion disk. This hot, swirling ring is how we often "see" black holes even though the hole itself is black.

🔭 Types of Black Holes

  • Stellar black holes — A few to dozens of times the Sun's mass
  • Supermassive black holes — Millions or billions of times the Sun's mass, found at galaxy centers
  • Intermediate black holes — Rare middle-sized ones scientists are still studying

Sagittarius A* is the supermassive black hole at the center of our Milky Way galaxy!

📸 First Photo of a Black Hole

In 2019, the Event Horizon Telescope team released the first image of a black hole's shadow — a supermassive one in galaxy M87, about 55 million light-years away!

Scientists linked radio telescopes around the world to work together like one giant eye in space.

🚀 Are Black Holes Dangerous?

Black holes don't go around sucking up planets like vacuum cleaners! From far away, their gravity works like any other mass of the same size.

You would only be in danger if you flew very, very close — and no astronaut has done that!

  </style>
<script>
(function (w) {
  var BOOK = "solarsystem";
  function key(name) {
    return "book:" + BOOK + ":" + name;
  }
  w.SolarPlayer = {
    getUserName: function () {

    },
    getCharacter: function () {
