    },
    getCharacterName: function () {
      return localStorage.getItem(key("characterName")) || localStorage.getItem("characterName") || "Astronaut";
    },
    save: function (name, character, characterName) {
      localStorage.setItem(key("userName"), name);
      localStorage.setItem(key("userCharacter"), character);
      if (characterName != null) localStorage.setItem(key("characterName"), characterName);
      localStorage.setItem("userName", name);
      localStorage.setItem("userCharacter", character);
      if (characterName != null) localStorage.setItem("characterName", characterName);
    },
  };
})(window);
</script>
</head>
<body class="big-game-page">
<div class="game-shell">
    <div class="title">Before we dive in into chapters, lets play game first</div>
    <div class="ui-container">
        <div class="ui-item">
            <span class="ui-label">⭐ Score:</span>
            <span class="ui-value" id="scoreDisplay">0</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ui-item">
            <span class="ui-label">🏆 Level:</span>
            <span class="ui-value" id="levelDisplay">1</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ui-item">
            <span class="ui-label">❤️ Lives:</span>
            <span class="ui-value" id="livesDisplay">5</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="stage-wrap">
    <div class="game-stage">
    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="700" height="600"></canvas>

    <div class="level-clear-toast" id="levelClearToast" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="toast-title" id="levelClearTitle">Level 1 Cleared!</div>
        <div class="toast-sub" id="levelClearSub">Great job defending the Sun!</div>
    </div>

    <div class="start-screen" id="startScreen">
        <h1>🌞 Solar System Defender</h1>
        <p>Protect the Sun! Drag on the game to aim the cannon.<br>Auto-fire every 250ms! Destroy asteroids before they hit!<br><strong>Clear 5 levels to win!</strong></p>
        <button class="btn" onclick="startGame()">▶️ Start Game</button>
    </div>

    <div class="game-over-screen" id="gameOverScreen" style="display: none;">
        <h1>💥 Game Over</h1>
        <p id="finalStats">Final Score: 0 | Level: 1</p>
        <button class="btn" onclick="restartGame()">🔄 Restart</button>
    </div>

    <div class="game-over-screen game-complete-screen" id="gameCompleteScreen" style="display: none;">
        <h1>🎉 Game Completed!</h1>
        <p>You defended the Sun through all 5 levels!</p>
        <p id="completeStats">Final Score: 0</p>
        <button class="btn" onclick="restartGame()">🔄 Play Again</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
</div>

    <script>
        // Game setup
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const width = canvas.width;
        const height = canvas.height;
        const centerX = width / 2;
        const centerY = height / 2;
        const GAME_SCALE = 1;
        const sunRadius = 50 * GAME_SCALE;
        const MAX_LEVEL = 5;
        const SCORE_PER_LEVEL = 200;

        // Game state
        let gameRunning = false;
        let score = 0;
        let lives = 5;
        let level = 1;
        let levelClearTimeout = null;
        let completeGameTimeout = null;
        let gameFinished = false;
        let cannonAngle = -Math.PI / 2; // Start pointing up
        let lastFireTime = 0;
        const fireInterval = 250; // ms

        // Game objects
        let bullets = [];
        let asteroids = [];
        let particles = [];
        let stars = [];

        // Input state
        let isAiming = false;
        let keys = {};

        // Initialize stars for background
        function initStars() {
            stars = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                stars.push({
                    x: Math.random() * width,
                    y: Math.random() * height,
                    radius: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
                    alpha: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.3
                });
            }
        }

        // Draw stars
        function drawStars() {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a1a';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
            
            stars.forEach(star => {
                ctx.globalAlpha = star.alpha;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            });
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }

        // Draw sun
        function drawSun() {
            const glowOuter = sunRadius + 80 * GAME_SCALE;
            const glowMid = sunRadius + 40 * GAME_SCALE;
            // Big glow
            const glow1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, 0, centerX, centerY, glowOuter);
            glow1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 100, 0, 0.3)');
            glow1.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 150, 0, 0.1)');
            glow1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 200, 0, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = glow1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, glowOuter, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            
            // Smaller glow
            const glow2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, 0, centerX, centerY, glowMid);
            glow2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.4)');
            glow2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 200, 0, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = glow2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, glowMid, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            
            // Sun body
            const sunGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX - 10 * GAME_SCALE, centerY - 10 * GAME_SCALE, 10 * GAME_SCALE, centerX, centerY, sunRadius);
            sunGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fffacd'); // Light yellow
            sunGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#ffd700'); // Gold
            sunGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#ffa500'); // Orange
            sunGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8c00'); // Dark orange
            ctx.fillStyle = sunGrad;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, sunRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            
            // Sunspots
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.4)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX - 20 * GAME_SCALE, centerY - 10 * GAME_SCALE, 8 * GAME_SCALE, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX + 15 * GAME_SCALE, centerY + 15 * GAME_SCALE, 6 * GAME_SCALE, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX + 5 * GAME_SCALE, centerY - 20 * GAME_SCALE, 5 * GAME_SCALE, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        // Draw cannon
        function drawCannon() {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(centerX, centerY);
            ctx.rotate(cannonAngle + Math.PI / 2);
            
            const barrelW = 20 * GAME_SCALE;
            const barrelH = 70 * GAME_SCALE;
            const tipW = 24 * GAME_SCALE;
            const tipH = 12 * GAME_SCALE;
            const baseR = 25 * GAME_SCALE;
            
            // Cannon barrel
            ctx.fillStyle = '#8b4513'; // Brown
            ctx.fillRect(-barrelW / 2, -90 * GAME_SCALE, barrelW, barrelH);
            
            // Cannon tip
            ctx.fillStyle = '#654321'; // Darker brown
            ctx.fillRect(-tipW / 2, -95 * GAME_SCALE, tipW, tipH);
            
            // Cannon base
            ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, baseR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            
            ctx.restore();
        }

        // Spawn asteroid
        function spawnAsteroid() {
            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const distance = Math.max(width, height) / 2 + 50;
            const size = (20 + Math.random() * 30) * GAME_SCALE;
            const speed = (1 + Math.random() * 1.5) + (Math.min(level, MAX_LEVEL) - 1) * 0.3;
            
            asteroids.push({
                x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
                y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * distance,
                radius: size,
                speed: speed,
                angle: angle + Math.PI // Move towards center
            });
        }

        // Fire bullet
        function fireBullet() {
            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastFireTime < fireInterval) return;
            lastFireTime = now;
            
            bullets.push({
                x: centerX + Math.cos(cannonAngle) * 100 * GAME_SCALE,
                y: centerY + Math.sin(cannonAngle) * 100 * GAME_SCALE,
                vx: Math.cos(cannonAngle) * 12,
                vy: Math.sin(cannonAngle) * 12,
                radius: 8 * GAME_SCALE
            });
        }

        // Create explosion
        function createExplosion(x, y, color, count = 15) {
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 2;
                particles.push({
                    x: x,
                    y: y,
                    vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
                    vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
                    radius: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
                    color: color,
                    life: 1
                });
            }
        }

        function clearPendingTimers() {
            if (levelClearTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(levelClearTimeout);
                levelClearTimeout = null;
            }
            if (completeGameTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(completeGameTimeout);
                completeGameTimeout = null;
            }
        }

        function hideLevelClearToast() {
            const toast = document.getElementById('levelClearToast');
            if (!toast) return;
            toast.classList.remove('show');
        }

        function showLevelClearToast(clearedLevel) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('levelClearToast');
            const title = document.getElementById('levelClearTitle');
            const sub = document.getElementById('levelClearSub');
            if (!toast || !title || !sub) return;

            clearPendingTimers();
            hideLevelClearToast();

            title.textContent = `Level ${clearedLevel} Cleared!`;
            if (clearedLevel >= MAX_LEVEL) {
                sub.textContent = 'All levels complete — amazing work!';
            } else {
                sub.textContent = `Level ${clearedLevel + 1} incoming — keep defending the Sun!`;
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(() => toast.classList.add('show'));

            levelClearTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                hideLevelClearToast();
                levelClearTimeout = null;
            }, 1600);
        }

        function scoreNeededForLevel(lvl) {
            return lvl * SCORE_PER_LEVEL;
        }

        function checkLevelProgress() {
            if (gameFinished || level > MAX_LEVEL) return;

            const threshold = scoreNeededForLevel(level);
            if (score < threshold) return;

            const clearedLevel = level;
            showLevelClearToast(clearedLevel);

            if (clearedLevel >= MAX_LEVEL) {
                gameRunning = false;
                completeGameTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    completeGame();
                    completeGameTimeout = null;
                }, 1700);
                return;
            }

            level = Math.min(clearedLevel + 1, MAX_LEVEL);
            document.getElementById('levelDisplay').textContent = level;
        }

        // Check collisions
        function checkCollisions() {
            // Bullet vs Asteroid
            for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const b = bullets[i];
                for (let j = asteroids.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                    const a = asteroids[j];
                    const dx = b.x - a.x;
                    const dy = b.y - a.y;
                    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
                    
                    if (dist < b.radius + a.radius) {
                        createExplosion(a.x, a.y, a.radius > 30 * GAME_SCALE ? '#ff6600' : '#ffaa00');
                        score += Math.floor(a.radius);
                        bullets.splice(i, 1);
                        asteroids.splice(j, 1);
                        
                        document.getElementById('scoreDisplay').textContent = score;
                        checkLevelProgress();
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Asteroid vs Sun
            for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const a = asteroids[i];
                const dx = a.x - centerX;
                const dy = a.y - centerY;
                const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
                
                if (dist < a.radius + sunRadius) {
                    createExplosion(a.x, a.y, '#ff4444', 25);
                    asteroids.splice(i, 1);
                    lives--;
                    document.getElementById('livesDisplay').textContent = lives;
                    
                    if (lives <= 0) {
                        endGame();
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Update game objects
        function update() {
            if (gameFinished) return;

            if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) cannonAngle -= 0.08;
            if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) cannonAngle += 0.08;
            
            // Auto fire
            fireBullet();
            
            // Update bullets
            for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const b = bullets[i];
                b.x += b.vx;
                b.y += b.vy;
                
                // Remove off-screen
                if (b.x < -50 || b.x > width + 50 || b.y < -50 || b.y > height + 50) {
                    bullets.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }
            
            // Update asteroids
            for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const a = asteroids[i];
                const dx = centerX - a.x;
                const dy = centerY - a.y;
                const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
                a.x += (dx / dist) * a.speed;
                a.y += (dy / dist) * a.speed;
            }
            
            // Update particles
            for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const p = particles[i];
                p.x += p.vx;
                p.y += p.vy;
                p.life -= 0.03;
                if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
            }
            
            checkCollisions();
        }

        // Draw everything
        function draw() {
            drawStars();
            drawSun();
            
            // Draw asteroids
            asteroids.forEach(a => {
                ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${30 + Math.random() * 20}, 60%, 40%)`;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                
                // Craters
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(a.x + a.radius * 0.3, a.y - a.radius * 0.2, a.radius * 0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            });
            
            // Draw bullets
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
            ctx.shadowColor = '#ffff00';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
            bullets.forEach(b => {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            });
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            
            drawCannon();
            
            // Draw particles
            particles.forEach(p => {
                ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
                ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            });
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }

        // Game loop
        let lastSpawn = 0;
        function gameLoop(timestamp) {
            if (!gameRunning) return;
            
            // Spawn asteroids
            const spawnInterval = Math.max(1400 - Math.min(level, MAX_LEVEL) * 100, 500);
            if (timestamp - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
                spawnAsteroid();
                lastSpawn = timestamp;
            }
            
            update();
            draw();
            
            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }

        // Start game
        function startGame() {
            clearPendingTimers();
            hideLevelClearToast();
            gameFinished = false;
            score = 0;
            lives = 5;
            level = 1;
            cannonAngle = -Math.PI / 2;
            bullets = [];
            asteroids = [];
            particles = [];
            lastSpawn = 0;
            
            document.getElementById('scoreDisplay').textContent = score;
            document.getElementById('livesDisplay').textContent = lives;
            document.getElementById('levelDisplay').textContent = level;
            document.getElementById('startScreen').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('gameOverScreen').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('gameCompleteScreen').style.display = 'none';
            
            gameRunning = true;
            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }

        // End game (lives lost)
        function endGame() {
            clearPendingTimers();
            hideLevelClearToast();
            gameFinished = true;
            gameRunning = false;
            document.getElementById('finalStats').textContent = `Final Score: ${score} | Level: ${level}`;
            document.getElementById('gameOverScreen').style.display = 'block';
        }

        function completeGame() {
            clearPendingTimers();
            hideLevelClearToast();
            gameFinished = true;
            gameRunning = false;
            document.getElementById('completeStats').textContent = `Final Score: ${score} | All ${MAX_LEVEL} levels cleared!`;
            document.getElementById('gameCompleteScreen').style.display = 'block';
        }

        // Restart game
        function restartGame() {
            startGame();
        }

        // Input handling
        document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            keys[e.key] = true;
        });
        document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
            keys[e.key] = false;
        });
        
        function aimFromPointer(clientX, clientY) {
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;
            const x = (clientX - rect.left) * (BASE_W / rect.width);
            const y = (clientY - rect.top) * (BASE_H / rect.height);
            cannonAngle = Math.atan2(y - centerY, x - centerX);
        }

        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
            if (!gameRunning) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            isAiming = true;
            aimFromPointer(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
        }, { passive: false });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
            if (!gameRunning || !isAiming) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            aimFromPointer(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
        }, { passive: false });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { isAiming = false; });
        canvas.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => { isAiming = false; });

        canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
            if (!gameRunning) return;
            isAiming = true;
            aimFromPointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        });
        window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
            if (!gameRunning || !isAiming) return;
            aimFromPointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        });
        window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isAiming = false; });

        // Fixed 700x600 game coordinates; letterbox uniformly into the stage (no stretch).
        const BASE_W = 700;
        const BASE_H = 600;

        function resizeCanvas() {
            const stage = document.querySelector('.game-stage');
            if (!stage) return;
            const displayW = stage.clientWidth;
            const displayH = stage.clientHeight;
            if (!displayW || !displayH) return;

            const fitScale = Math.min(displayW / BASE_W, displayH / BASE_H);
            const cssW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(BASE_W * fitScale));
            const cssH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(BASE_H * fitScale));

            canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
            canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
            canvas.style.left = Math.floor((displayW - cssW) / 2) + 'px';
            canvas.style.top = Math.floor((displayH - cssH) / 2) + 'px';

            const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
            canvas.width = Math.round(BASE_W * dpr);
            canvas.height = Math.round(BASE_H * dpr);
            ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

            if (!gameRunning) {
                drawStars();
                drawSun();
                drawCannon();
            }
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
        const stageEl = document.querySelector('.game-stage');
        if (stageEl && typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            new ResizeObserver(resizeCanvas).observe(stageEl);
        }

        // Initialize
        initStars();
        resizeCanvas();
    </script>
<script>
/* solar-ui-fit-frame */
(function () {
  function fitGameFrame() {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains("big-game-page")) return;
    const h = window.innerHeight + "px";
    document.documentElement.style.height = h;
    document.documentElement.style.minHeight = h;
    document.body.style.height = h;
    document.body.style.minHeight = h;
    const shell = document.querySelector(".game-shell");
    if (shell) {
      shell.style.height = h;
      shell.style.minHeight = h;
    }
  }
  fitGameFrame();
  window.addEventListener("resize", fitGameFrame);
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
    new ResizeObserver(fitGameFrame).observe(document.documentElement);
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

1. What is a black hole?
An empty hole in space
A region where gravity is so strong light cannot escape
A dark planet
A cloud of dust
2. What is the event horizon?
The surface of the Sun

A type of meteor shower

steps.title: Conclusion
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Conclusion

What an amazing journey through space!

🌟 What You've Learned

Congratulations on completing your journey through our solar system! You've learned about:

  • The Sun - our amazing star that gives us light and heat
  • Mercury - the smallest and fastest planet
  • Venus - the hottest planet with backwards rotation
  • Earth - our beautiful home planet
  • Mars - the red planet with the biggest volcano
  • Jupiter - the giant planet with the Great Red Spot
  • Saturn - the ringed planet that could float in water
  • Uranus - the ice giant that rolls on its side
  • Neptune - the windy planet discovered through math

🚀 The Future of Space Exploration

Space exploration is just beginning! Scientists and engineers are working on:

  • Sending humans to Mars
  • Building bases on the Moon
  • Exploring the moons of Jupiter and Saturn
  • Searching for life on other worlds
  • Building better telescopes to see farther into space

🌍 Why Space Matters

Learning about space helps us understand our place in the universe. It inspires us to dream big and work together to solve big problems.

Who knows? Maybe one day, YOU could be an astronaut exploring other planets, or a scientist discovering new worlds!

💡 Remember

The sky is not the limit - it's just the beginning!

📖 Keep Learning!

Your journey through the solar system is complete, but learning never stops! There's so much more to discover:

steps.title: OurSolarSystem AllPlanets
steps.contentHtml:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - All Planets</title>
  <style>
    *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;left:0;
      width:100%;height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}50%{opacity:0.8;}}
    .container{max-width:640px;margin:auto;padding:12px 14px 24px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px;}
    h1{font-size:28px;color:#a78bfa;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .subtitle{color:#c4b5fd;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;}
    .panel{
      background:#1a1735;
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:16px;
      margin-bottom:20px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .solar-panel{padding:12px;}
    .view-stage{
      position:relative;
      width:100%;
      margin:0 auto;
    }
    .view-layer{
      display:block;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      min-height:0;
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      opacity:0;
      visibility:hidden;
      transition:opacity 0.32s ease, visibility 0.32s;
      pointer-events:none;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .view-layer.active{
      opacity:1;
      visibility:visible;
      pointer-events:auto;
      z-index:2;
    }
    .view-layer-telescope.active{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      justify-content:flex-start;
    }
    .view-layer-telescope .telescope-wrap{
      flex:0 0 auto;
      min-height:0;
      max-height:min(62vw, calc(100svh - 210px));
      height:min(62vw, calc(100svh - 210px));
    }
    .view-layer-telescope .telescope-meta{display:none;}
    .view-layer-orbit .svg-wrap{
      height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      max-height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      aspect-ratio:1;
    }
    .vertical-fit{
      height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      max-height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      width:100%;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      overflow:hidden;
      border-radius:16px;
      background:#050510;
    }
    .vertical-fit svg{display:block;height:100%;width:auto;max-width:100%;}
    .telescope-wrap{
      height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      max-height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:row;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:8px;
      padding:8px 6px;
    }
    .tel-arrow{
      flex:0 0 auto;
      width:46px;
      height:46px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:50%;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);
      color:#fff;
      font-size:28px;
      line-height:1;
      cursor:pointer;
      box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    }
    .tel-arrow:active{transform:scale(0.94);}
    .telescope-stage{
      flex:1 1 auto;
      max-width:min(68vw, 360px);
      aspect-ratio:1;
      border-radius:28px;
      overflow:hidden;
      background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, #0a1028 0%, #020208 72%);
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), 0 0 30px rgba(255,180,60,0.08);
    }
    .telescope-stage svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;background:transparent;}
    .telescope-meta{
      width:100%;
      padding:0 10px 4px;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .telescope-label{
      font-size:clamp(15px, 4vw, 19px);
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#ffd700;
    }
    .telescope-detail{
      margin-top:6px;
      font-size:clamp(12px, 3.2vw, 15px);
      line-height:1.55;
      color:#c4b5fd;
    }
    .movie-wrap,.fp-wrap{
      height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      max-height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      width:100%;
      border-radius:16px;
      overflow:hidden;
      position:relative;
      background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, rgba(40,30,90,0.5), #050510 70%);
    }
    .view-layer-movie.active{
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
    }
    .view-layer-movie .movie-wrap{
      aspect-ratio:800 / 560;
      height:auto;
      max-height:calc(100svh - 132px);
    }
    .view-layer-vertical.active{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
    }
    .view-layer-vertical .vertical-fit{
      flex:0 0 auto;
      aspect-ratio:360 / 580;
      height:auto;
      max-height:calc(100svh - 148px);
    }
    .fp-wrap::after{
      content:'';
      position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;border-radius:16px;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,215,0,0.22), inset 0 -100px 90px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
    }
    .movie-wrap svg,.fp-wrap svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
    .svg-wrap{
      background:#12102a;
      border-radius:16px;
      overflow:hidden;
      touch-action:none;
      cursor:grab;
      aspect-ratio:1;
      width:100%;
      max-width:min(100%, 520px);
      height:auto;
      margin:0 auto;
    }
    .svg-wrap{position:relative;}
    .svg-wrap:active{cursor:grabbing;}
    .svg-wrap::after{
      content:'';
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      pointer-events:none;
      border-radius:16px;
      box-shadow:inset 0 -40px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,215,0,0.25);
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 130% 90% at 50% 118%, transparent 42%, rgba(0,0,0,0.42) 100%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,8,32,0.12) 0%, rgba(10,8,32,0) 35%, rgba(10,8,32,0.45) 100%);
    }
    #solarSvg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;}
    .planet-spin{will-change:transform;}
    .ctrl-row{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:nowrap;
      gap:6px;
      justify-content:center;
      margin-top:6px;
    }
    .ctrl-btn{
      padding:8px 10px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:10px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);
      color:#fff;
      font-family:inherit;
      font-size:12px;
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:transform 0.15s;
      flex:1 1 0;
      min-width:0;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .ctrl-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}
    .ctrl-btn:active{transform:scale(0.95);}
    .ctrl-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#ef4444);}
    .info-panel h2{color:#a78bfa;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:10px;}
    .info-panel p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;color:#e0e7ff;}
    .info-panel .hint{color:#c4b5fd;font-size:14px;margin-top:8px;}
    .minigame-panel h2{color:#a78bfa;font-size:20px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .minigame-panel .game-desc{text-align:center;color:#c4b5fd;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.5;}
    .progress-slots{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      gap:6px;
      justify-content:center;
      margin-bottom:16px;
    }
    .slot{
      width:36px;height:36px;
      border-radius:10px;
      background:#12102a;
      border:2px dashed rgba(167,139,250,0.4);
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      font-size:18px;
      transition:0.2s;
    }
    .slot.filled{
      border-style:solid;
      border-color:#a78bfa;
      background:#1a1735;
    }
    .planet-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
      gap:10px;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    @media(max-width:400px){.planet-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
    .planet-card{
      background:#12102a;
      border:2px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
      border-radius:14px;
      padding:12px 8px;
      text-align:center;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:transform 0.15s,border-color 0.15s,opacity 0.2s;
      user-select:none;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
    }
    .planet-card:hover:not(.done){transform:scale(1.05);border-color:#a78bfa;}
    .planet-card.done{opacity:0.35;pointer-events:none;cursor:default;}
    .planet-card .emoji{font-size:28px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .planet-card .name{font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;color:#c4b5fd;}
    @keyframes shake{

    }
    .planet-card.shake{animation:shake 0.35s ease-in-out;}
    .game-hint{
      text-align:center;
      font-size:15px;
      color:#fbbf24;
      min-height:22px;
      margin-bottom:10px;
    }
    .win-banner{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(102,126,234,0.3),rgba(118,75,162,0.3));

      border-radius:16px;

      return [M.vbW, M.vbH, M.boost, M.cx].join('|');
    },
    ensureVerticalScene() {
      const key = this._vertSceneKey();
      if (this._sceneCache.verticalKey === key && this._sceneCache.vertical) return;
      const g = this.verticalG;
      const svg = document.getElementById('verticalSvg');
      if (!g || !svg) return;
      const L = VERT_LINE;
      const M = this.verticalMetrics();
      const cx = M.cx;
      const scale = M.boost * (L.sizeScale || 1);
      const sunR = L.sunR * scale;
      while (g.firstChild) g.removeChild(g.firstChild);
      this.drawSubtleSky(g, M);
      const cache = { sunSpin: null, planetSpins: {} };
      const sunY = -sunR * 0.58;
      const sunG = el('g', { class: 'planet-hit', 'data-id': 'sun', style: 'cursor:pointer' });
      g.appendChild(sunG);
      const sunInner = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
      sunG.appendChild(sunInner);
      cache.sunSpin = sunInner;
      sunInner.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + cx + ',' + sunY.toFixed(1) + ')');
      this.drawVerticalSun(sunInner, sunR, svg);
      sunInner.appendChild(el('circle', {
        r: String(sunR * 0.95),
        fill: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.001)',
        'pointer-events': 'all'
      }));
      const step = (L.bottomY - L.topY) / (PLANETS.length + 1);
      PLANETS.forEach((p, i) => {
        const y = L.topY + step * (i + 1);
        const r = (MOVIE_SIZES[p.id] || 24) * scale;
        const hitR = p.id === 'saturn' ? r * 1.35 : r + 8;
        const pg = el('g', {
          class: 'planet-hit',
          'data-id': p.id,
          transform: 'translate(' + cx + ',' + y.toFixed(1) + ')',
          style: 'cursor:pointer'
        });
        g.appendChild(pg);
        const spinG = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
        pg.appendChild(spinG);
        cache.planetSpins[p.id] = spinG;
        this.drawPlanetRealistic(spinG, p, r, svg);
        pg.appendChild(el('circle', {
          r: String(hitR),
          fill: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.001)',
          'pointer-events': 'all'
        }));
      });
      this._sceneCache.vertical = cache;
      this._sceneCache.verticalKey = key;
      this.updateVerticalAnim();
    },
    updateVerticalAnim() {
      const cache = this._sceneCache.vertical;
      if (!cache) return;
      if (cache.sunSpin) {
        const base = cache.sunSpin.getAttribute('data-base') || cache.sunSpin.getAttribute('transform') || '';
        if (!cache.sunSpin.getAttribute('data-base')) cache.sunSpin.setAttribute('data-base', base);
        const spin = (this.sunSpin || 0).toFixed(2);
        cache.sunSpin.setAttribute('transform', base + ' rotate(' + spin + ')');
      }
      PLANETS.forEach(p => {
        const spinG = cache.planetSpins[p.id];
        if (spinG) {
          spinG.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (this.spinAngles[p.id] || 0).toFixed(2) + ')');
        }
      });
    },
    _orbitSceneKey() {
      const M = this.syncOrbitViewBox() || {};
      const mode = this.currentMode();
      const layout = this.effectiveOrbitLayout(mode);
      return [
        M.vbW, M.vbH, M.wide ? 1 : 0,
        layout.tilt, layout.orbitScale, layout.sunRadius,
        layout.sunOffsetX, layout.planetSizeScale, mode.id
      ].join('|');
    },
    ensureOrbitScene() {
      const key = this._orbitSceneKey();
      if (this._sceneCache.orbitKey === key && this._sceneCache.orbit) return;
      const M = this.syncOrbitViewBox() || { vbW: 600, vbH: 600, x0: 0, y0: 0, cx: 300, cy: 300 };
      let skyG = this.svg.querySelector('#orbitSkyGroup');
      if (!skyG) {
        skyG = el('g', { id: 'orbitSkyGroup' });
        this.svg.insertBefore(skyG, this.viewG);
      }
      while (skyG.firstChild) skyG.removeChild(skyG.firstChild);
      this.drawSubtleSky(skyG, M);
      while (this.viewG.firstChild) this.viewG.removeChild(this.viewG.firstChild);
      const mode = this.currentMode();
      const layout = this.effectiveOrbitLayout(mode);
      const wide = M.wide || this.orbitStageWide();
      const sunR = layout.sunRadius;
      const sunX = layout.sunOffsetX;
      const hostSvg = this.svg;
      const cache = {
        backG: el('g', { id: 'orbitBackPlanets' }),
        frontG: el('g', { id: 'orbitFrontPlanets' }),
        planets: {},
        sunG: null,
      };
      this.viewG.appendChild(el('g', { id: 'orbitEllipses' }));
      this.viewG.appendChild(cache.backG);
      const sunG = el('g', {
        id: 'sunHit',
        class: 'planet-hit',
        'data-id': 'sun',
        transform: 'translate(' + sunX + ',0)',
        style: 'cursor:pointer'
      });
      this.viewG.appendChild(sunG);
      cache.sunG = sunG;
      this.drawSun(sunG, sunR, hostSvg);
      this.viewG.appendChild(cache.frontG);
      this.visiblePlanets(mode).forEach(p => {
        const orbitR = this.displayOrbitR(p, layout);
        this.viewG.firstChild.appendChild(el('ellipse', {
          cx: sunX, cy: 0, rx: orbitR, ry: orbitR * Math.abs(layout.tilt),
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.42)',
          'stroke-width': wide ? '1.8' : '1.5'
        }));
        const drawSize = p.size * layout.planetSizeScale;
        const pg = el('g', {
          class: 'planet-hit',
          'data-id': p.id,
          style: 'cursor:pointer'
        });
        const spinG = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
        pg.appendChild(spinG);
        this.drawPlanetBody(spinG, p, drawSize, hostSvg);
        cache.planets[p.id] = { pg: pg, spinG: spinG };
      });
      this._sceneCache.orbit = cache;
      this._sceneCache.orbitKey = key;
      this.updateOrbitAnim();
    },
    updateOrbitAnim() {
      const cache = this._sceneCache.orbit;
      if (!cache || !this.viewG) return;
      const mode = this.currentMode();
      const layout = this.effectiveOrbitLayout(mode);
      const cx = 300;
      const cy = mode.viewCy != null ? mode.viewCy : (this.VIEW_CY || 300);
      const rot = this.rot + this.drag;
      const tilt = layout.tilt;
      const sunX = layout.sunOffsetX;
      this.viewG.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + cx + ',' + cy + ') rotate(' + rot + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ')');
      const drawList = this.buildPlanetDrawList(mode, null, tilt, layout).sort((a, b) => a.py - b.py);
      drawList.forEach(item => {
        const node = cache.planets[item.p.id];
        if (!node) return;
        const spin = (this.spinAngles[item.p.id] || 0).toFixed(2);
        node.pg.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + item.px.toFixed(2) + ',' + item.py.toFixed(2) + ') scale(' + item.scale.toFixed(3) + ')');
        node.spinG.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + spin + ')');
        const parent = item.py < 0 ? cache.backG : cache.frontG;
        if (node.pg.parentNode !== parent) parent.appendChild(node.pg);
      });
      if (cache.sunG) {
        cache.sunG.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + sunX + ',0)');
      }
    },
    _telescopeSceneKey() {
      return String(this.telescopeIdx);
    },
    ensureTelescopeScene() {
      const key = this._telescopeSceneKey();
      if (this._sceneCache.telescopeKey === key && this._sceneCache.telescope) return;
      const g = this.telescopeG;
      const svg = document.getElementById('telescopeSvg');
      if (!g || !svg) return;
      const M = this.syncStageViewBox('telescopeSvg', 400, 400, 'tele');
      if (!M) return;
      while (g.firstChild) g.removeChild(g.firstChild);
      g.appendChild(el('rect', { x: String(M.x0), y: String(M.y0), width: String(M.vbW), height: String(M.vbH), fill: '#030308' }));
      const starCount = LOW_GPU ? 36 : 72;
      for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
        g.appendChild(el('circle', {
          cx: String(M.x0 + ((i * 53.7 + 12) % Math.max(1, M.vbW - 12))),
          cy: String(M.y0 + ((i * 91.3 + 28) % Math.max(1, M.vbH - 12))),
          r: String(0.35 + (i % 5) * 0.22),
          fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.2 + (i % 7) * 0.1).toFixed(2) + ')'
        }));
      }
      if (!svg.querySelector('#telVignette')) {
        let defs = svg.querySelector('defs');
        if (!defs) {
          defs = el('defs', {});
          svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
        }
        const rg = el('radialGradient', { id: 'telVignette', cx: '50%', cy: '48%', r: '58%' });
        rg.appendChild(el('stop', { offset: '50%', 'stop-color': 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' }));
        rg.appendChild(el('stop', { offset: '100%', 'stop-color': 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)' }));
        defs.appendChild(rg);
      }
      const contentG = el('g', {
        transform: 'translate(' + M.cx.toFixed(2) + ',' + M.cy.toFixed(2) + ') scale(' + M.boost.toFixed(4) + ') translate(-200,-200)'
      });
      g.appendChild(contentG);
      const p = PLANETS[this.telescopeIdx];
      const pg = el('g', {
        class: 'planet-hit',
        'data-id': p.id,
        transform: 'translate(200,200)',
        style: 'cursor:pointer'
      });
      contentG.appendChild(pg);
      const spinG = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
      pg.appendChild(spinG);
      this.drawPlanetSoft(spinG, p, TELESCOPE_DRAW_R, svg);
      g.appendChild(el('rect', {
        x: String(M.x0), y: String(M.y0), width: String(M.vbW), height: String(M.vbH),
        fill: 'url(#telVignette)', 'pointer-events': 'none', opacity: '0.45'
      }));
      this._sceneCache.telescope = { spinG: spinG };
      this._sceneCache.telescopeKey = key;
      this.updateTelescopeAnim();
    },
    updateTelescopeAnim() {
      const cache = this._sceneCache.telescope;
      if (!cache || !cache.spinG) return;
      const p = PLANETS[this.telescopeIdx];
      cache.spinG.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (this.spinAngles[p.id] || 0).toFixed(2) + ')');
    },
    _movieSceneKey() {
      const M = this.syncMovieViewBox();
      if (!M) return '';
      return [M.vbW, M.vbH, M.wide ? 1 : 0, M.boost].join('|');
    },
    ensureMovieScene() {
      const key = this._movieSceneKey();
      if (this._sceneCache.movieKey === key && this._sceneCache.movie) return;
      const g = this.movieG;
      const svg = document.getElementById('movieSvg');
      if (!g || !svg) return;
      const ML = MOVIE_LAYOUT;
      const M = this.syncMovieViewBox();
      if (!M) return;
      while (g.firstChild) g.removeChild(g.firstChild);
      this.drawSubtleSky(g, M);
      let contentG;
      let startX;
      let endX;
      let sunR;
      if (M.wide) {
        contentG = el('g', {
          transform: 'translate(' + M.originX.toFixed(2) + ',' + M.cy.toFixed(2) + ') scale(' + M.boost.toFixed(4) + ') translate(0,' + (-ML.centerY) + ')'
        });
        startX = M.rowStartX;
        endX = M.rowEndX;
        sunR = ML.sunR;
      } else {
        contentG = el('g', {
          transform: 'translate(' + M.cx.toFixed(2) + ',' + M.cy.toFixed(2) + ') scale(' + M.boost.toFixed(4) + ') translate(' + (-ML.centerX) + ',' + (-ML.centerY) + ')'
        });
        startX = ML.startX;
        endX = ML.endX;
        sunR = ML.sunR;
      }
      g.appendChild(contentG);
      const glowPad = Math.ceil(sunR * 0.22);
      const sunWrap = el('g', { 'clip-path': 'url(#movieSunLeftClip)' });
      let defs = svg.querySelector('defs');
      if (!defs) {
        defs = el('defs', {});
        svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
      }
      let cp = svg.querySelector('#movieSunLeftClip');
      if (!cp) {
        cp = el('clipPath', { id: 'movieSunLeftClip' });
        defs.appendChild(cp);
      }
      while (cp.firstChild) cp.removeChild(cp.firstChild);
      cp.appendChild(el('rect', {
        x: '0',
        y: String(-glowPad),
        width: '460',
        height: String(ML.contentH + glowPad * 2)
      }));
      contentG.appendChild(sunWrap);
      const sunG = el('g', {
        transform: 'translate(' + ML.sunCX + ',' + ML.centerY + ')',
        class: 'planet-hit',
        id: 'sunHit',
        'data-id': 'sun',
        style: 'cursor:pointer'
      });
      sunWrap.appendChild(sunG);
      this.drawSunBurning(sunG, sunR, svg, null);
      const cache = { planetSpins: {} };
      const lineY = ML.centerY;
      const gap = (endX - startX) / (PLANETS.length - 1);
      PLANETS.forEach((p, i) => {
        const x = startX + gap * i;
        const r = MOVIE_SIZES[p.id] || 24;
        const pg = el('g', {
          class: 'planet-hit',
          'data-id': p.id,
          transform: 'translate(' + x.toFixed(1) + ',' + lineY + ')',
          style: 'cursor:pointer'
        });
        contentG.appendChild(pg);
        const spinG = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
        pg.appendChild(spinG);
        cache.planetSpins[p.id] = spinG;
        this.drawMoviePlanet(spinG, p, r, svg);
      });
      this._sceneCache.movie = cache;
      this._sceneCache.movieKey = key;
      this.updateMovieAnim();
    },
    updateMovieAnim() {
      const cache = this._sceneCache.movie;
      if (!cache) return;
      PLANETS.forEach(p => {
        const spinG = cache.planetSpins[p.id];
        if (spinG) {
          spinG.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (this.spinAngles[p.id] || 0).toFixed(2) + ')');
        }
      });
    },
    drawOrbit(){
      this.ensureOrbitScene();
      this.updateOrbitAnim();
    },
    drawVertical() {
      this.ensureVerticalScene();
      this.updateVerticalAnim();
    },
    drawTelescope() {
      this.ensureTelescopeScene();
      this.updateTelescopeAnim();
    },
    drawMovie() {
      this.ensureMovieScene();
      this.updateMovieAnim();
    },
    loop(){
      const layer = this.activeLayer();
      if (this.playing){
        const mult = SPEEDS[this.speedIdx];
        PLANETS.forEach(p => {
          this.angles[p.id] += p.baseSpeed * mult;
          this.spinAngles[p.id] = (this.spinAngles[p.id] || 0) + 0.5 * mult;
        });
        this.sunSpin = (this.sunSpin || 0) + 0.35 * mult;
      }
      this.tickActiveView();
      requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop());
    }
  };

  /* ── Order the Planets Minigame ── */
  const Game = {
    step: 0, done: false,
    init(){
      this.slots = document.getElementById('progressSlots');
      this.grid = document.getElementById('planetGrid');
      this.hint = document.getElementById('gameHint');
      this.win = document.getElementById('winBanner');
      this.orderList = document.getElementById('orderList');
      document.getElementById('playAgain').onclick = () => this.reset();
      this.reset();
    },
    reset(){
      this.step = 0;
      this.done = false;
      this.win.classList.add('hidden');
      this.hint.textContent = 'Tap Mercury first — it\'s the closest to the Sun!';
      this.slots.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++){
        const s = document.createElement('div');
        s.className = 'slot';
        s.textContent = i + 1;
        this.slots.appendChild(s);
      }
      this.orderList.innerHTML = '';
      PLANET_ORDER.forEach(name => {
        const p = PLANETS.find(x => x.name === name);
        const item = document.createElement('span');
        item.className = 'order-item';
        item.textContent = p.emoji + ' ' + name;
        this.orderList.appendChild(item);
      });
      const shuffled = [...PLANETS].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
      this.grid.innerHTML = '';
      shuffled.forEach(p => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'planet-card';
        card.dataset.name = p.name;
        card.innerHTML = '<span class="emoji">' + p.emoji + '</span><span class="name">' + p.name + '</span>';
        card.onclick = () => this.tap(card, p);
        this.grid.appendChild(card);
      });
    },
    tap(card, p){
      if (this.done || card.classList.contains('done')) return;
      const expected = PLANET_ORDER[this.step];
      if (p.name === expected){
        card.classList.add('done');
        const slot = this.slots.children[this.step];
        slot.textContent = p.emoji;
        slot.classList.add('filled');
        this.step++;
        if (this.step >= 8){
          this.done = true;
          this.win.classList.remove('hidden');
          this.hint.textContent = '🌟 Amazing! You know the order of the planets!';
        } else {
          const next = PLANET_ORDER[this.step];
          const nextP = PLANETS.find(x => x.name === next);
          this.hint.textContent = 'Nice! Now tap ' + next + ' ' + nextP.emoji;
        }
      } else {
        card.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('shake'), 350);
        const nextP = PLANETS.find(x => x.name === expected);
        this.hint.textContent = 'Not quite! Hint: tap ' + expected + ' ' + nextP.emoji + ' next.';
      }
    }
  };

  Game.init();
  try { Solar.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Solar viewer:', err); }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: OurSolarSystem Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Our Solar System Explained

Learn how our cosmic neighborhood works!

🌟 What is the Solar System?

The solar system is our cosmic neighborhood in space. It's like a big family with the Sun at the center and all the planets orbiting around it.

Orbit means going around in a circle. Just like the Moon orbits around Earth, all the planets orbit around the Sun!

☀️ The Sun - Our Star

The Sun is a star, not a planet! It's a huge ball of hot, glowing gas that gives us light and heat. Without the Sun, Earth would be freezing cold and dark.

💡 Fun Fact

The Sun is so big that over 1 million Earths could fit inside it!

🪐 The 8 Planets

There are 8 planets in our solar system. They are divided into two groups:

  • Inner Planets (closer to the Sun): Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars
  • Outer Planets (farther from the Sun): Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune

📏 Order from the Sun

☀️
The Sun
Center of our system
🪨
Mercury
Smallest planet
🔥
Venus
Hottest planet
🌍
Earth
Our home
🔴
Mars
The red planet
🟠
Jupiter
Biggest planet
💍
Saturn
Has beautiful rings
🔵
Uranus
Ice giant
🔷
Neptune
Windiest planet

🌙 Other Objects in Space

Besides the Sun and planets, our solar system has many other interesting things:

  • Moons - Many planets have moons that orbit around them
  • Asteroids - Rocky objects that orbit the Sun, mostly between Mars and Jupiter
  • Comets - Dirty snowballs that leave beautiful tails when they get close to the Sun

🚀 Why is Earth Special?

Earth is the only planet we know of that has life! It's just the right distance from the Sun - not too hot and not too cold. It has water, air, and everything living things need.

💡 Fun Fact

Earth is often called the "Goldilocks Planet" because it's just right for life!

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="playerScore">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="vs-divider">VS</div>
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="botIcon">🤖</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="botName">SolarBot</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What is at the center of our solar system?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Earth</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">The Sun</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">The Moon</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. How many planets are in our solar system?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">7</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">9</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">8</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">10</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Saturn</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. Which planet is the largest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Earth</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Saturn</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Neptune</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. Which planet has beautiful rings?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">Saturn</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Uranus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Neptune</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-6">
    <div class="question">6. Which planet is the hottest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">Mercury</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, true)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">The Sun</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-6"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-7">
    <div class="question">7. Which planet is the smallest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, true)">Mercury</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Earth</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-7"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-8">
    <div class="question">8. Which planet is our home?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, false)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, false)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, true)">Earth</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, false)">Jupiter</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-8"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="score-card" id="scoreCard">
    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🤖</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">SolarBot</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="message" id="scoreMessage"></div>
    <div class="button-group">
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 8;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'SolarBot';
  const botCharacter = '🤖';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: The Sun
steps.contentHtml:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - The Sun</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:24px 16px 40px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:20px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:32px;
      color:#ffd700;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .sun-display{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:center;
      margin:30px 0;
    }
    .sun{
      width:150px;
      height:150px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffd700,#ff8c00);
      border-radius:50%;
      box-shadow:0 0 80px #ffd700,0 0 120px #ff8c00;
      animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:transform 0.3s;
    }
    .sun:hover{
      transform:scale(1.1);
    }
    @keyframes pulse{
      0%,100%{transform:scale(1);}
      50%{transform:scale(1.05);}
    }
    .card{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:20px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .card h2{
      color:#ffd700;
      margin-bottom:12px;
      font-size:20px;
    }
    .card p{
      font-size:16px;
      line-height:1.7;
      margin-bottom:10px;
    }
    .fact-box{
      background:rgba(251,191,36,0.2);
      border-left:6px solid #fbbf24;
      padding:16px;
      border-radius:12px;
      margin-top:12px;
    }
    .fact-box h3{
      color:#fbbf24;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      font-size:18px;
    }
    .fact-box p{
      font-size:15px;
      line-height:1.6;
      margin:0;
    }
    .stats-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
      gap:12px;
      margin-top:12px;
    }
    .stat-item{
      background:rgba(255,215,0,0.1);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:14px;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .stat-label{
      font-size:13px;
      color:#c4b5fd;
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .stat-value{
      font-size:18px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#ffd700;
    }
    .nav-hint{
      margin-top:20px;
      text-align:center;
      font-size:13px;
      color:#a78bfa;
      background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
      padding:10px;
      border-radius:10px;
    }
    .sun-game{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:20px;
      margin-top:20px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .sun-game h2{color:#ffd700;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:20px;text-align:center;}
    .sun-game .game-desc{text-align:center;color:#c4b5fd;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.55;}
    .game-canvas-wrap{position:relative;height:min(50vh,440px);min-height:min(42vh,300px);max-height:min(56vh,480px);background:#12102a;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;}
    .game-canvas-wrap:active{cursor:grabbing;}
    .game-hud-float{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;right:8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;}
    .game-hud-float span{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.65);padding:5px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffd700;border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.35);}
    .game-drag-hint{
      position:absolute;
      bottom:8px;
      left:50%;
      transform:translateX(-50%);
      z-index:6;
      pointer-events:none;
      max-width:calc(100% - 16px);
      padding:5px 10px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,0.62);
      border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.35);
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:bold;
      text-align:center;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    #sunGameCanvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
    .game-canvas-wrap .game-overlay{
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;
      left:50%;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:10px;
      box-sizing:border-box;
      width:min(92%,300px);
      max-width:calc(100% - 16px);
      max-height:calc(100% - 20px);
      overflow-y:auto;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
      background:rgba(8,6,24,0.94);
      padding:16px 14px;
      border-radius:14px;
      text-align:center;
      border:2px solid #ffd700;
      z-index:10;
    }
    .game-overlay h3{
      color:#ffd700;
      margin:0;
      font-size:clamp(15px,4.2vw,20px);
      line-height:1.25;
    }
    .game-overlay p{
      color:#ddd;
      margin:0;
      font-size:clamp(11px,3vw,14px);
      line-height:1.45;
      max-width:100%;
    }
    .overlay-btn{
      flex-shrink:0;
      margin-top:2px;
      padding:9px 22px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);
      color:#fff;
      font-size:clamp(13px,3.5vw,15px);
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
    }
    @media (max-height: 700px) {
      .game-canvas-wrap .game-overlay {
        padding: 12px;
        gap: 8px;
      }
    }
    .game-hud{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;}
    .game-hud-item{background:#1a1735;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffd700;border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.45);}
    .touch-controls{display:none;}
  
    .planet-svg-panel{background:#12102a;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.45);padding:12px;margin:20px 0;}
    .svg-viewport{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;max-height:min(72vw,260px);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0820;touch-action:none;}
    .svg-viewport svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;cursor:grab;}
    .planet-info-panel{margin-top:10px;min-height:52px;padding:12px 14px;background:#1a1735;border-radius:12px;border-left:4px solid #ffd700;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;}
    .planet-info-panel strong{color:#ffd700;font-size:15px;}
    .svg-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:10px;}
    .svg-ctrl{padding:10px 14px;border:none;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;}
    .svg-ctrl.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#ef4444);}
    .game-desc{text-align:center;color:#c4b5fd;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.55;padding:0 8px;}
    .game-hud{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;}
    .game-hud-item{background:#1a1735;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffd700;border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.45);}
    .game-canvas{position:relative;}

  /* big-planet-first-view */

  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;

body.big-planet-page:has(.sun-game) .container {

  max-height: none !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  display: block;
}

const sunFacts = [

  "The Sun's gravity keeps all the planets in orbit!",

  "The Sun is actually a yellow dwarf star!",

// ☀️ Solar Climb — Mario-style platform climb to the Sun
let sunCanvas, sunCtx, sunRunning = false;
let sunPlayer, sunPlatforms = [], sunFlares = [], sunCamY = 0;
let sunStartPlat = null;
let sunTime = 90, sunLives = 3, sunHeight = 0, sunAnimId, sunTimerId;
let sunKeys = {}, sunDragMove = 0, sunJumpReq = false;
let sunDragPointerId = null, sunDragStartX = 0, sunDragStartY = 0, sunDragStartTime = 0;
let sunPhys = { grav: 0.58, jumpV: -10.2, speed: 4.8, maxJumpH: 76, maxJumpX: 130 };
const SUN_BODY_RADIUS = 45;
const SUN_RAY_LEN = 34;
const SUN_CENTER_Y = 72;

function sunPhysicsFor(w, h) {
  const scale = Math.max(1, Math.min(w, h) / 380);
  const grav = 0.58;
  const jumpV = -10.2 * Math.min(1.28, 0.9 + scale * 0.14);
  const speed = 4.8 * Math.min(1.22, 0.94 + scale * 0.1);
  const maxJumpH = (jumpV * jumpV) / (2 * grav) * 0.88;
  const airFrames = (-2 * jumpV / grav) * 0.9;
  const maxJumpX = speed * airFrames * 0.88;
  return { grav: grav, jumpV: jumpV, speed: speed, maxJumpH: maxJumpH, maxJumpX: maxJumpX };
}

function startSunClimb() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('sunGameWrap');
  sunCanvas = document.getElementById('sunGameCanvas');
  sunCtx = sunCanvas.getContext('2d');
  sunCanvas.width = wrap.clientWidth;
  sunCanvas.height = wrap.clientHeight;
  document.getElementById('sunStartScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('sunEndScreen').style.display = 'none';
  const dragHint = document.getElementById('sunDragHint');
  if (dragHint) dragHint.style.display = 'block';
  sunRunning = true;
  sunTime = 90; sunLives = 3; sunHeight = 0; sunCamY = 0;
  sunFlares = [];
  sunKeys = {}; sunDragMove = 0; sunJumpReq = false; sunDragPointerId = null;
  sunPhys = sunPhysicsFor(sunCanvas.width, sunCanvas.height);
  sunPlatforms = buildSunPlatforms(sunCanvas.width, sunCanvas.height, sunPhys);
  const startPlat = sunPlatforms.find(p => p.isStart) || sunPlatforms.filter(p => !p.isSun).reduce((a, b) => (a.y > b.y ? a : b));
  sunStartPlat = startPlat;
  sunPlayer = {
    x: startPlat.x + startPlat.width / 2,
    y: startPlat.y - 14,
    w: 24, h: 28, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: true
  };
  sunCamY = sunBottomCamY(startPlat, sunCanvas.height);
  updateSunHud();
  document.addEventListener('keydown', sunKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', sunKeyUp);
  bindSunDragControls();
  if (sunTimerId) clearInterval(sunTimerId);
  sunTimerId = setInterval(function() {
    if (!sunRunning) return;
    sunTime--;
    updateSunHud();
    if (sunTime <= 0) endSunClimb(false);
  }, 1000);
  sunLoop();
}

function buildSunPlatforms(w, h, phys) {
  phys = phys || sunPhysicsFor(w, h);
  const sunCx = w / 2;
  const sunW = Math.max(104, 108);
  const plats = [{
    x: sunCx - sunW / 2,
    y: SUN_CENTER_Y,
    width: sunW,

  let y = h - 20;
  const startW = Math.max(88, Math.min(w - 24, 124));
  let prevCx = sunCx;
  plats.push({ x: prevCx - startW / 2, y: y, width: startW, h: 14, isStart: true });
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    const nextY = y - (gapMin + Math.random() * (gapMax - gapMin));
    if (nextY < minPlatY) break;
    y = nextY;
    const pw = Math.max(72, Math.min(w * 0.3, 78 + Math.random() * 36));
    const dx = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * maxDx;
    let cx = prevCx + dx;
    cx = Math.max(pw / 2 + 10, Math.min(w - pw / 2 - 10, cx));
